etymology.historical_story: The basket named keranjang belongs to the material vocabulary of woven bamboo and rattan. DBP's example pictures two baskets carried on a shoulder pole, linking the word with transporting goods. Its compounds lead in different directions: keranjang sampah names a household container, while bola keranjang names a sport. These connections explain usage, rather than proving a particular borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 keranjang 想成一只“大筐”：水果装筐，垃圾进篓，bola keranjang 则把球投进篮框。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀；词末 ng 表示 /ŋ/。mengalungkan 中 meN- 在 k 前变为 meng-，词根首音 k 脱落。

word_family.gloss: 把项链、花环等挂到颈上

senses.zh_definition: 戴在颈部的装饰品，如金项链、珠串或花环；项链；颈饰。
senses.en_definition: An ornament worn around the neck, such as a necklace or a garland.
senses.ms_definition: Benda hiasan daripada emas, batu permata dan sebagainya yang dipakai di leher; rantai leher.
senses.nuances: 通常指装饰性颈饰；rantai leher 在马来西亚日常交流中也很常见。项链可用量词 seutas。kalungan bunga 也可指献放的花圈，因此并非所有 kalungan 都戴在颈上。参见：[DBP 饰物义及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kalung)。

senses.zh_definition: 一种高大乔木的马来俗名，词典记为 Alangium nobile，又称 medang biawak 或 setebal。
senses.en_definition: A tall tree identified in the dictionary as Alangium nobile, also called medang biawak or setebal.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok tinggi, Alangium nobile, yang juga dinamakan medang biawak atau setebal.
senses.nuances: 这是植物名称，与项链义分列。词典另列 akar kalung，指 Piper lanatum；akar kalung gajah 或 akar kalung ular 指 Piper ribesioides，均不可误当成这棵乔木的根。以下为植物语境的识别性组合，非日常高频搭配。参见：[DBP 植物义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kalung)。

senses.zh_definition: 投掷；向某物或某个目标扔东西，属于登嘉楼方言。
senses.en_definition: To throw or pelt, in Terengganu dialect.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam dialek Terengganu, membaling.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标注 Tr，表示登嘉楼方言。通用标准马来语用 membaling 或 melontar；不能把这个方言动词理解为“戴项链”。以下为说明方言用法的组合，非全国通用高频搭配。参见：[DBP 方言义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kalung)。

do not throw, in Terengganu dialect

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Cantiklah kalung ni! Kau beli kat mana?

etymology.historical_story: Kalung places ornament around the neck, whether the material is gold, beads, gemstones, or flowers. Its Malay derivatives preserve that image: berkalung describes wearing it, while mengalungkan describes placing it on someone. Kalungan extends to ring-shaped arrangements, including wreaths. These connections explain the word family without assuming an unverified ancient borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kalung 末尾的 /ŋ/ 像轻轻收住一个环：想象颈上一圈珠链；berkalung＝戴着，mengalungkan＝给人挂上。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将形容词 bodoh 名词化，表示愚笨的性质或状态；词根拼写不变，末尾 h 在接元音后缀 -an 时成为下一音节的声母：ke.bo.do.han。

word_family.gloss: 使愚昧；把人当傻瓜；愚弄
愚弄或使人愚昧的过程

senses.zh_definition: 愚笨、愚昧或缺乏判断力的状态、性质；也可指体现这种愚蠢的行为。
senses.en_definition: Stupidity or foolishness; a lack of understanding or sound judgement, or conduct displaying it.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bodoh, kebebalan, kedunguan, ketololan.
senses.nuances: 带明显贬义，通常比单纯“不知道”更严厉。不要把缺乏信息、受教育机会不足或一次普通错误一概称为 kebodohan。它表示状态或表现；pembodohan 则强调使人愚昧或愚弄人的过程。参见：[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kebodohan)。

senses.zh_definition: 错误；误会；弄错之处，属于雅加达地区用法。
senses.en_definition: A mistake or error, in Jakarta regional usage.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan Jakarta, kesalahan atau kekeliruan.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标注 Jk，表示雅加达用法。马来西亚一般语境不会把它当作中性的“错误”；标准交流宜用 kesalahan、kesilapan 或 kekeliruan。以下搭配用于说明地区义，不代表马来西亚高频用法。参见：[DBP 地区义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kebodohan)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam sesi latihan itu, fasilitator menegaskan bahawa kesilapan peserta tidak wajar dianggap sebagai bukti kebodohan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该培训中，引导师强调，不应把参与者的错误视为愚笨的证明。
dual_scenarios.en: During the training session, the facilitator stressed that participants' mistakes should not be treated as evidence of stupidity.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku malu lah bila teringat kebodohan aku tadi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya berasa malu apabila teringat akan kebodohan saya tadi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 想起刚才自己干的蠢事，我都觉得丢脸。

spoken_features: aku 用于熟人之间的自述。
lah 加强尴尬、懊恼的语气。
tak 对应 tidak。
je 对应 sahaja，可用于安慰时淡化事情的严重性。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku malu lah bila teringat kebodohan aku tadi. Aku salah sebut nama pelanggan.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berasa malu apabila teringat akan kebodohan saya tadi. Saya tersalah menyebut nama pelanggan.
messages.zh: 想到刚才自己干的蠢事就觉得丢脸。我把客户名字叫错了。
messages.en: I'm so embarrassed about how foolish I was earlier. I got the client's name wrong.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak payah keras sangat dengan diri sendiri. Tersasul je tadi, bukan sengaja pun.

messages.en: Don't be so hard on yourself. It was just a slip of the tongue—you didn't do it on purpose.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 kebodohan awak 或 kebodohan kamu 容易构成人身羞辱，对长辈、学生、同事或下属尤其不合适。讨论具体问题时可改用 kesilapan、kekeliruan 或 kurang memahami。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 kebodohan awak 或 kebodohan kamu 容易构成人身羞辱，对长辈、学生、同事或下属尤其不合适。讨论具体问题时可改用 kesilapan、kekeliruan 或 kurang memahami。

etymology.historical_story: Kebodohan is transparently formed from bodoh with the Malay circumfix ke-...-an, turning a description into a noun for a condition. DBP illustrates it through Pak Kaduk, a familiar figure of foolishness in Malay storytelling. That cultural association helps explain its evaluative force: the word judges conduct rather than neutrally reporting missing information.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: bodoh＝愚笨；ke-...-an 给它套上“这种状态”的框：kebodohan＝愚笨的状态或表现。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 表示状态、事件或遭受某种情况；词根末尾的 r 与 -an 重新划分音节，形成 ke.bo.co.ran。词包将整词误标为词根，此处按实际构词修正。

senses.zh_definition: 液体、气体等通过孔洞或缝隙漏入或漏出的现象或状态。
senses.en_definition: The escape or entry of liquid or gas through a hole or faulty seal; leakage.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau kejadian bocor yang menyebabkan air, gas atau bahan lain keluar atau masuk melalui lubang atau celah.
senses.nuances: 着重泄漏这一状态或事件，不自动表示有人故意造成泄漏。可用于管道、屋顶、水箱及输送系统。[DBP：bocor 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pembocoran)

senses.zh_definition: 秘密、资料或受限制的信息被未经授权地披露或传播。
senses.en_definition: The unauthorized disclosure or exposure of confidential information.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan apabila rahsia, maklumat sulit atau data yang dilindungi diketahui oleh pihak yang tidak berhak.
senses.nuances: kebocoran 侧重信息已经外泄的事件或结果；pembocoran 更侧重泄露行为。单用 kebocoran 不足以断定泄露者或其动机。

senses.zh_definition: 发生漏水、漏气等情况，或受到泄漏的影响。
senses.en_definition: To develop a leak or suffer the effects of leakage.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalami bocor atau menanggung akibat daripada sesuatu yang bocor.
senses.nuances: 这是词典所列 mengalami bocor 的状态性用法。现代说明文常写 mengalami kebocoran，使句子结构更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Kebocoran is transparently formed from bocor with the Malay circumfix ke-...-an. Its meanings connect physical leakage with the disclosure of secrets: both involve something crossing a boundary that should contain it. This provides a useful cultural bridge between familiar leaking roofs or boats and modern discussions of confidential documents and personal data.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bocor 想成“漏了”，再用 ke-...-an 把它装进“状态或事件”的框：kebocoran＝泄漏这件事。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，在现代马来语中作为完整词根使用；末尾 -i 不是马来语后缀。派生词 mengkategorikan、pengkategorian 保留词根开头的 k。

senses.zh_definition: 分类体系中依据某些共同特征划分的类别、组别或门类。
senses.en_definition: A class or division in a classification system, defined by shared characteristics.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian dalam sesuatu sistem klasifikasi atau golongan yang ditentukan berdasarkan ciri-ciri tertentu.
senses.nuances: 可用于竞赛组别、商品类别、年龄分组和资料分类。它强调分类标准，不必然表示高低等级；没有明确分级时，不宜直接译为“级别”。释义依据：[DBP：kategori](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=kategori)。

senses.zh_definition: 哲学中构成理解、判断或概念体系基础的范畴。
senses.en_definition: A fundamental conceptual category underlying understanding or thought in philosophy.
senses.ms_definition: Asas atau dasar sesuatu pengertian dalam falsafah.
senses.nuances: 这是哲学专门义，中文通常译为“范畴”。具体范畴的划分取决于所讨论的哲学体系。

etymology.historical_story: Kategori entered Malay from English category, according to DBP's origin label. Its everyday usefulness lies in turning shared features into named groups: competition entries, products and documents can all be organised this way. The philosophical sense preserves a deeper question behind classification: which basic concepts allow people to understand and describe their world? [DBP origin and senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=kategori).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kategori 与英语 category 成对记忆，再想象给物品贴上“类别”标签；整个词一起记，不拆出虚构词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的后附着形式，严格说属于附着代词，此处依结构归入 suffix；连接时不发生音变。它可标记整个名词短语的归属，例如 rumah kecilku 是“我的小房子”。原包无音节资料，此处补为 ke.cil.ku；所给 Jawi کچيل 仅拼写词根，完整形式按构词补写为 کچيلکو。

word_family.gloss: 变小；词首 k 在鼻音前缀后脱落

senses.zh_definition: 小的、面积或体积不大的；带 -ku 时，可在名词短语中表示所修饰的事物属于“我”，如“我的小房间”。
senses.en_definition: Small in size or extent, with enclitic -ku marking the containing noun phrase as belonging to the speaker.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak besar, tidak luas atau tidak lebar; bentuk kecil yang diikuti oleh kata ganti singkat -ku untuk menandai hubungan milik dengan penutur dalam frasa nama.
senses.nuances: 这不是另一个独立词根，而是 kecil 与 -ku 的组合。rumah kecilku 对应 rumah kecil saya，不应逐字误解为“房子是我的小”。词根释义参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=kecil)；附着代词连写规则参见 [DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 年幼的、尚在孩童时期的；在 masa kecilku、zaman kecilku 等短语中，整体表示“我的童年”。
senses.en_definition: Young or in childhood; in phrases such as masa kecilku, referring to the speaker's childhood.
senses.ms_definition: Masih muda atau masih kanak-kanak; dalam frasa seperti masa kecilku, merujuk kepada masa penutur masih kanak-kanak.
senses.nuances: “童年”义来自整个时间短语，并非 kecilku 在所有语境中都单独等于“我的童年”。这种 -ku 形式适合回忆、自述和文学表达；一般正式交流常用 masa kecil saya，日常聊天常说 masa aku kecil。

etymology.historical_story: Kecilku illustrates Malay's practice of attaching shortened pronouns to a preceding word. Here, kecil supplies the descriptive meaning, while -ku connects the expression to aku, the speaker. In masa kecilku, that compact ending makes a childhood reference personal. The form is therefore a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical root. See [DBP's spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kecil 是“小”，-ku 连着 aku“我”：masa kecilku，就是“我小时候的那段时光”。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -i 接在词根后，末尾 t 保留；kh 表示 /x/，部分说话者读作 /h/。khianati 用于祈使句及 saya、kami、kita 等参与的第二式被动结构；普通主动陈述通常用 mengkhianati。输入包未提供音节，故保留 null；可按 khia.na.ti 教学。headword.jawi 按输入保留，但 خيانت 对应词根 khianat，khianati 的完整拼写应为 خيانتي。

senses.ms_definition: Tidak menjaga kepercayaan atau amanah yang telah diberikan.
senses.nuances: 是背叛义用于抽象宾语的常见延伸；不必涉及投敌，但仍带有强烈的道德谴责。正式主动形式为 mengkhianati kepercayaan 或 mengkhianati amanah。

etymology.historical_story: Khianat comes from Arabic khiyānah, meaning treachery or betrayal. In Malay, the borrowed base participates in local word formation: khianati adds the suffix i, while mengkhianati supplies the usual active form. Historical Malay usage connects the word with betrayal of people and communities, illustrating how an Arabic ethical term became part of everyday Malay vocabulary. See [ANU's Malay Concordance Project](https://mcp.anu.edu.au/papers/laffan_apc.php).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 khianat＝背叛，再加 -i 指向被背叛的对象：khianati amanah＝辜负托付；主动陈述再加 meng-：mengkhianati。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根；词尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。添加 meN- 时，词首 k 脱落：meN- + kandung → mengandung。

senses.nuances: 这一独立名词义主要见于旧式叙述或文学语言；现代日常表达通常用 kantung、pundi-pundi 或 dompet。此义没有常见的现代高频搭配，以下列出符合原义的用法。

senses.zh_definition: 子宫；孕育胎儿的器官。

senses.zh_definition: 亲生的；与亲属称谓连用，表示具有直接血缘关系。
senses.en_definition: Biological or related by birth, used after a kinship term.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai pertalian darah sendiri, bukan hubungan tiri atau angkat.
senses.nuances: 现代最常见的用法，置于亲属称谓之后，如 ibu kandung。父母、子女关系译为“亲生”；兄弟姐妹关系须结合上下文判断，不应机械地把所有 adik kandung 都解释为同父同母；需要明确时可说 seibu sebapa。

etymology.historical_story: Traditional dictionary senses place kandung beside both a pouch and the womb. These meanings offer a memorable image of something held within, while kinship expressions identify relationships by birth. The related forms mengandung and kandungan preserve this semantic network. This connection explains the vocabulary without claiming a documented chronological order for its different meanings.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kandung 想成“装在里面”：钱装在袋里，胎儿在腹中；ibu kandung 就是孕育自己的生母。这是语义联想，不是词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Kartu belongs to the vocabulary borrowed from Dutch kaart in the Indonesian and wider archipelagic contact setting. A Dutch loanword survey records related card words in several regional languages. DBP marks kartu as Indonesian and records both ordinary cards and playing cards, while Malaysian usage generally favors kad. The contrast preserves a visible trace of different language-contact histories. [Sources: Dutch loanword survey](https://pure.knaw.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/458170/Nww_compleet_archief.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kartu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kar- 联想 card，“卡”就抓住核心意思；再记地域搭档：印尼常说 kartu，马来西亚常说 kad。

etymology.historical_story: DBP labels kendali as Javanese and records its concrete association with a bridle or reins. Its abstract meanings offer a useful image: directing an organisation resembles guiding a horse, while restraining emotion resembles holding the reins. This illustrates the relationship between recorded senses rather than establishing a dated history of semantic change. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150324&keyword=kendali).

senses.zh_definition: 数一数、算一算；以强调或劝请语气要求计算。

senses.nuances: 常见于祈使句。-lah 的效果取决于语调：既可温和邀请，也可加强催促；并非固定表示礼貌。

senses.zh_definition: 算作、看作；根据当前情况作出带有语气强调的判断。
senses.en_definition: To regard or count something as a particular thing or state.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap atau menilai sesuatu sebagai sesuatu yang tertentu, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 如 Kiralah ini hadiah daripada saya，表示“就当这是我送的礼物”。口语 Itu kiralah murah 表示“那算便宜了”；不表示进行数值计算。

senses.zh_definition: 在 tidak kiralah 等结构中表示不论、不管，不以某项差别为条件。
senses.en_definition: In expressions such as tidak kiralah, to disregard a distinction or condition; regardless of.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan seperti tidak kiralah, menunjukkan bahawa sesuatu perbezaan atau keadaan tidak dijadikan syarat atau pertimbangan.
senses.nuances: 这是完整结构的意义，不能把独立 kiralah 一律翻译为“不论”。口语常说 tak kiralah；正式书面语可用 tanpa mengira。DBP 的实际用例包括“不论哪种油炸方式”的用法，见 [DBP 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=char)。

etymology.historical_story: Kiralah combines the familiar root kira with the Malay emphatic particle -lah. The result shows how grammar shapes everyday meaning: a speaker may invite someone to calculate, ask them to regard something in a certain way, or dismiss a distinction in tak kiralah. These are contextual developments of a transparent formation, not evidence for an invented foreign origin. See [DBP on -lah](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kira 是“算”，-lah 给它加语气：kiralah“算吧”；tak kiralah“别计较这个了／都行”。

etymology.historical_story: Kabir illustrates how a Malay dictionary can preserve a base mainly through its derived verb. Kamus Dewan explains this entry through mengabir, covering reaching, pulling and scooping. The same spelling also belongs to a separate Arabic-derived word meaning large or great. Keeping these homonyms apart prevents an attractive but unsupported origin story: the action sense has no established connection to Arabic greatness.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ka-bir 想成“卡住的东西，伸手一搂拉过来”。再记 meN- 吃掉词首 k：kabir → mengabir。只是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的直接基底 keluarkan；更深层词根是 keluar。-kan 构成及物使动形式，-nya 在本条常作宾语附着代词。-nya 严格说是附着成分，按给定字段归入 suffix；ny 表示 /ɲ/，连接时无词根音变。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. Keluar expresses outward movement; adding -kan makes something or someone move outward, while -nya supplies a reference recoverable from context. The same outward image extends to money leaving an account, publications reaching readers, and people being removed from membership. [DBP: keluar and its derivatives](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=keluar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: keluar＝出去，-kan＝使其出去，-nya＝它／他／她：合起来就是“把它取出来”，再由语境扩展为发布、付款或除名。

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed kontraktor from English contractor as a complete occupational term. Its cultural setting is the world of agreements: one party commissions work, while another undertakes to deliver it. Malaysian usage strongly associates the word with building projects, although the dictionary also includes contracted services and supplies. The underlying idea is responsibility accepted through a contract. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=kontraktor)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontrak（合同）与 kontraktor（承包商）成对记：接下合同、负责交付的一方就是 kontraktor；这是词义联想，不是本土词缀拆解。

morphology.formula: ∅ + keep → keep（英语原形，用于语码转换）
morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节词，ee 表示 /iː/。输入的 syllables 值 sst 不是有效音节切分，已更正。这里不分析为马来语派生词。

senses.en_definition: To retain or store something; used as an English insertion in Malay conversation.
senses.ms_definition: Menyimpan atau terus memiliki sesuatu; digunakan sebagai sisipan bahasa Inggeris dalam percakapan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语夹用，不应标为正式马来语词。正式表达按语境使用 simpan、menyimpan 或 mengekalkan；释义为编写说明。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=keep)

senses.ms_definition: Mengekalkan keadaan atau hubungan, atau meneruskan sesuatu kegiatan.

etymology.historical_story: English keep descends from Old English cēpan, whose recorded meanings included observing, attending to, and holding. Its deeper origin is uncertain. In Malay conversation, an occurrence of keep should be understood through its English meaning and surrounding Malay syntax; its appearance does not itself establish that it is a standardized Malay loanword. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/keep)

morphology.formula: ke（方向介词）+ belakang（后方）→ ke belakang
morphology.pattern_note: 表示“向后”时规范写作 ke belakang，ke 是独立介词，不是前缀；输入中把 kebelakang 认作词根的分析已更正。音标对应规范短语。

senses.zh_definition: 向后，朝与前方相反的方向；规范形式为 ke belakang。
senses.en_definition: Backwards or towards the rear; standard spelling: ke belakang.
senses.ms_definition: Ke arah yang berlawanan dengan hadapan.

etymology.historical_story: Malay ke belakang combines the directional preposition ke with belakang, meaning the back or rear. The dictionary also records a polite toilet euphemism, showing how a spatial expression can acquire an indirect social meaning. The joined spelling kebelakang should not obscure this structure or be confused with kebelakangan ini, meaning recently. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=ke+belakang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ke＝往，belakang＝后方：两个单位分开写，就是“往后”。

etymology.historical_story: Kenny is used in Scottish and English naming traditions as a familiar form of Kenneth. etymology.historical_story: Keji is treated as an independent root in modern Malay; its opening ke is not a detachable prefix. Its dictionary family connects moral judgment with social action: mengeji expresses condemnation, while kekejian names vileness or disgraceful conduct. This established usage explains its strong force, without requiring an unsupported story about an ancient source language. [DBP：keji](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=keji)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ke-ji，先轻读 /kə/，再读 /dʒi/；联想“可鄙至极”的行为，记住它比普通的“坏”更重。

morphology.formula: ke（方向介词）+ bawah（下方）→ ke bawah（向下）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入 kebawah 是规范短语 ke bawah 的非规范连写形式；这里的 ke 是独立介词，不是前缀，因此必须分写。输入包把 kebawah 标为词根属于待纠正分析；实际核心词为 bawah。无词缀音变。参见 [DBP：ke bawah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ke+bawah)。

senses.zh_definition: 向下；往较低的位置或地方。规范写作 ke bawah。
senses.en_definition: Downwards; towards a lower place or position. Standard spelling: ke bawah.
senses.ms_definition: Ke tempat yang lebih rendah.
senses.nuances: 本条记录输入 kebawah，但教授的规范形式是 ke bawah。结构上属于介词短语，在句中常作方向状语，因此在限定词性集合中标作 adverb。表示朝下的方向；静态的“在下面”通常用 di bawah。参见 [DBP：ke bawah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ke+bawah)。

senses.zh_definition: 向较低的水平或等级；接在年龄、数值等界限之后时，表示该界限及以下。
senses.en_definition: Towards a lower level or rank; following a numerical limit, at that limit or below.
senses.ms_definition: Ke paras atau peringkat yang lebih rendah; selepas had umur atau angka, menunjukkan had itu dan nilai yang lebih rendah.
senses.nuances: 这是空间方向向等级和数值范围的延伸。12 tahun ke bawah 通常包括十二岁；kurang daripada 12 tahun 才明确表示未满十二岁。数值范围义不同于静态空间位置义。基本等级义见 [DBP：ke bawah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ke+bawah)；这里的完整马来语释义为编辑性展开。

etymology.historical_story: Ke bawah combines the directional preposition ke with bawah, meaning the lower part or position. Its spatial meaning extends naturally to lower levels, ranks and numerical ranges. Malay spelling preserves the two words because ke remains a preposition here. The joined input kebawah should therefore be taught through the standard phrase rather than invented affixation. [DBP：ke bawah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ke+bawah)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ke 是“往”，bawah 是“下方”：ke | bawah＝往下走。两块分开写，方向一眼明白。

etymology.historical_story: Kipas connects the hand fan with the electric fan through one familiar experience: moving air brings relief from heat. Malay also uses the related verb mengipas figuratively for flattering someone to gain an advantage. This semantic connection makes the word memorable, although it does not establish the word's ultimate historical origin or a particular borrowing route.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟着 ki-pas 两拍，想象扇子来回扇两下；给身体“送风”是 mengipas，给上司“送好话”也可比喻为 mengipas。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 按输入包保留；实际构词基础是 tegang，而非不可分析的单纯词。ke-...-an 将形容词名词化，表示状态；前两个 e 读 /ə/，ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，词根辅音不脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 物体或身体组织绷紧、紧缩的状态；紧绷。
senses.en_definition: The state of being physically taut or tense.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau keadaan tegang.
senses.nuances: 本义涉及肌肉、组织或其他物体的紧绷。专业语境须区分 ketegangan 与表示特定物理量的 tegangan，依学科术语选用。[DBP：ketegangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ketegangan)。

senses.zh_definition: 因担忧、压力或悬念而产生的心理紧张状态。
senses.en_definition: Mental or emotional tension caused by anxiety, pressure, or suspense.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan tegang dari segi perasaan atau fikiran.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP“状态紧张”义在心理领域的细分释义；此处马来语释义为展开说明。可描述个人情绪或故事营造的紧张感，不必然表示人与人发生冲突。

senses.zh_definition: 各方激烈对立所造成的紧张、尖锐或危急局势。
senses.en_definition: A strained or critical situation arising from serious conflict between parties.
senses.ms_definition: Pertentangan yang keras, kegentingan, keruncingan.
senses.nuances: 常见于政治、外交、社会关系及新闻报道，表示关系恶化或冲突风险上升；不意味着已经爆发战争或肢体冲突。

dah 是 sudah 的缩略形式。

messages.ms_standard: Ketegangan sudah sedikit reda. Selepas semua orang berehat sebentar, suasana menjadi tenang.
messages.zh: 缓和一点了。大家休息了一会儿，气氛就平静下来了。
messages.en: A little. Things calmed down after everyone took a short break.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于汇报时语气客观，但指出团队存在 ketegangan 仍可能涉及敏感关系，宜说明具体情境，避免直接归咎某个人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻、调解、职场沟通及身心状态描述。普通聊天可以使用，但描述自己紧张时，saya rasa tegang 往往更直接。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于汇报时语气客观，但指出团队存在 ketegangan 仍可能涉及敏感关系，宜说明具体情境，避免直接归咎某个人。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻、调解、职场沟通及身心状态描述。普通聊天可以使用，但描述自己紧张时，saya rasa tegang 往往更直接。

etymology.historical_story: Ketegangan belongs to the family of tegang, meaning taut or tense. The Malay circumfix ke-...-an turns that quality into a noun naming a condition. Its dictionary meanings connect physical tightness with serious opposition or crisis. As a learning image, a stretched cord helps explain why strained relationships can also be described through tension. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ketegangan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tegang＝绷紧，再用 ke-...-an 把性质装成“状态”：肌肉绷紧是 ketegangan，关系绷紧也是 ketegangan。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-…-an 将形容词 senang 名词化，表示舒适、愉快或安逸的状态。词根末尾 /ŋ/ 在接元音后成为下一音节的声母，读作 ke.se.na.ngan；ng 不拆成 /nɡ/。

senses.zh_definition: 愉快、满足或内心舒畅的状态；从某事中获得的乐趣。
senses.en_definition: Pleasure, happiness, satisfaction, or a feeling of contentment.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan berasa gembira, puas atau tenteram; rasa nikmat yang diperoleh daripada sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可表示安静的满足，也可表示享受，不一定是兴奋或热闹。与 hati 搭配时偏向内心舒畅；描述好玩活动时，keseronokan 往往更直接。词义依据：[DBP：kesenangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kesenangan)。

senses.zh_definition: 生活安逸、物质较充裕而少受困苦的状态。
senses.en_definition: Ease or comfort in life, especially freedom from material hardship.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan hidup yang selesa dan tidak dibebani kesusahan, terutama dari segi kebendaan.
senses.nuances: 强调生活境况舒适，未必达到奢华或巨富程度。虽然 senang 也可表示容易，但 kesenangan 不能在所有场合替代 kemudahan；公共设施通常称 kemudahan。

dual_scenarios.ms: Program latihan itu bertujuan meningkatkan pendapatan peserta supaya mereka dapat menikmati kesenangan hidup.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该培训计划旨在提高参与者的收入，让他们能够过上较为安逸的生活。
dual_scenarios.en: The training programme aims to raise participants' incomes so that they can enjoy a more comfortable life.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku bukan nak kaya sangat, nak kesenangan hidup sikit je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya tidak mahu menjadi terlalu kaya; saya hanya mahu sedikit kesenangan hidup.

spoken_features: aku 用于熟人之间。
nak 对应 mahu 或 hendak。
sikit 对应 sedikit，je 对应 sahaja。
口语中省略重复主语，使表达更简短。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku bukan nak kaya sangat, nak kesenangan hidup sikit je.
messages.ms_standard: Saya tidak mahu menjadi terlalu kaya; saya hanya mahu sedikit kesenangan hidup.
messages.zh: 我也没想大富大贵，就想日子过得舒坦一点。

messages.ms_standard: Saya faham. Jika tidak lagi bimbang tentang wang setiap bulan, tentu berasa sedikit lega, bukan?

messages.en: I get it. Not having to worry about money every month would be a relief, wouldn't it?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 祝愿别人获得 kesenangan hidup 通常表达善意。谈自己的生活条件时，适度表达较自然；在正经历经济困难的人面前，避免炫耀享受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于生活目标、幸福感及物质条件。mencari kesenangan 本身可以中性，但若与 mengabaikan tanggungjawab 等表达连用，就会带有只顾享乐的批评意味。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 祝愿别人获得 kesenangan hidup 通常表达善意。谈自己的生活条件时，适度表达较自然；在正经历经济困难的人面前，避免炫耀享受。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于生活目标、幸福感及物质条件。mencari kesenangan 本身可以中性，但若与 mengabaikan tanggungjawab 等表达连用，就会带有只顾享乐的批评意味。

etymology.historical_story: Kesenangan is formed within Malay from senang using the state-noun circumfix ke-…-an. Its cultural associations include the familiar proverb about enduring hardship first and enjoying ease afterward. That connection helps explain why the word can suggest both personal contentment and improved living conditions: comfort is something experienced inwardly and secured through everyday effort. [DBP proverb explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kesenangan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: senang 是“轻松、舒适”，ke-…-an 像给状态装上名词外框：kesenangan＝那份轻松、安逸与满足。

morphology.pattern_note: 词尾 k 在马来西亚常读作喉塞音 [ʔ]；meN- + koyak → mengoyak，词首 k 脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 撕裂的；因拉扯、钩挂等而出现裂口或破损的。
senses.en_definition: Torn or ripped, with a split or opening in the material.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam keadaan carik atau rabak akibat bahan terpisah atau terbelah.
senses.nuances: 基本义描述衣物、纸张、皮肤等的破损状态。要明确表达“把某物撕破”的动作，标准主动形式通常用 mengoyakkan。参见 [DBP 的 koyak 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7876&keyword=koyak)。

senses.zh_definition: 撕开或撕破；常见于命令句及省略前缀的口语表达。
senses.en_definition: To tear or rip; used as a bare verb in commands and colloquial speech.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan sesuatu carik atau terbuka dengan menarik atau menyentaknya.
senses.nuances: 如 Jangan koyak kertas itu。该用法与标准派生动词 mengoyakkan 对应；它不同于形容词义的“已经破了”。

senses.zh_definition: 破防的；因批评、嘲弄、失败或压力而感到受伤、恼怒、失落或情绪失衡的。
senses.en_definition: Emotionally rattled, offended or upset, especially by criticism, ridicule or defeat; slang.
senses.ms_definition: Tersinggung, kecewa atau terganggu emosinya akibat kritikan, ejekan, kekalahan atau tekanan; bahasa slanga.
senses.nuances: 俚语义，不应因词头 status 为 official 而视作正式书面用法。可用于自嘲，也可带挑衅意味；不是心理疾病诊断。其情绪义及社交媒体用法见 [UNIMAS 的语义扩展研究](https://ir.unimas.my/id/eprint/40141/)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pemeriksaan mendapati bahawa beberapa beg penghantaran koyak dan perlu diganti sebelum digunakan semula.

dah 是 sudah 的口语形式
koyak 在此使用情绪受挫的俚语义

messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah koyak sikit lepas baca komen tu.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式报告使用物理义没有问题；表达情绪时宜按实际意思改用 tersinggung、kecewa 或 tertekan。涉及真实痛苦时，应避免拿 koyak 当笑话。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述物品破损时语气中性。对别人说 Jangan koyak 可能显得嘲讽或否定其感受；朋友间自嘲较容易被接受。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式报告使用物理义没有问题；表达情绪时宜按实际意思改用 tersinggung、kecewa 或 tertekan。涉及真实痛苦时，应避免拿 koyak 当笑话。

etymology.historical_story: Koyak starts with a visible tear in cloth, paper or another surface. Contemporary slang carries that image into emotional life: criticism can leave someone feeling as though their composure has ripped. A 2022 UNIMAS study documents this semantic expansion in social-media usage, connecting the established physical meaning with newer expressions of hurt and disappointment.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 koyak 记成“裂开”：衣服裂开是破了，情绪防线裂开就是口语里的“破防了”。

morphology.pattern_note: 环缀 ke-...-an 构成表示性质、状态或相关事物的名词；词根保持不变，末尾 /ŋ/ 与 -an 连读成为 /ŋan/。

senses.zh_definition: 虚假不实的性质或情况；与事实不符的言论、说法或谎言。
senses.en_definition: The state or quality of being false; an untrue statement or lie.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bohong; sesuatu yang bohong.
senses.nuances: 既可泛指虚假，也可指一项具体谎言。侧重虚假的内容或性质；pembohongan 则侧重实施欺骗的行为。直接把别人的说法称为 kebohongan，通常带有明显指责。[DBP 词义辨析](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bohong)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan siasatan itu membongkar kebohongan dalam kenyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh pihak berkenaan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 调查报告揭穿了有关方面所发布声明中的谎言。
dual_scenarios.en: The investigation report exposed falsehoods in the statement issued by the party concerned.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah terbongkar pun kebohongan dia tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kebohongannya itu sudah terbongkar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他那个谎已经被揭穿了。
dual_scenarios.en: His lie has already been exposed.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
dia tu 是 dia itu 的口语表达；kebohongan dia 对应较紧凑的 kebohongannya。
pun 在此加强已经发生的语气，不表示“也”。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah tengok bukti tu. Cerita dia penuh dengan kebohongan lah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah melihat bukti itu. Ceritanya penuh dengan kebohongan.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jangan kongsi kat grup dulu. Kita tanya dia elok-elok je.
messages.ms_standard: Jangan kongsikan perkara itu dalam kumpulan dahulu. Kita bertanya kepadanya dengan baik sahaja.
messages.zh: 先别往群里发。我们好好问问他就行。
messages.en: Don't share it in the group yet. Let's just ask him calmly.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 当面指称某人的说法为 kebohongan，容易被理解为指责对方撒谎。证据尚不充分时，可用 maklumat yang tidak tepat“信息不准确”或 kenyataan yang belum disahkan“尚未核实的说法”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于事实核查、揭露欺骗和明确讨论谎言的场合。它不等同于一般错误，也不宜仅因意见不同就用来评价他人。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 当面指称某人的说法为 kebohongan，容易被理解为指责对方撒谎。证据尚不充分时，可用 maklumat yang tidak tepat“信息不准确”或 kenyataan yang belum disahkan“尚未核实的说法”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于事实核查、揭露欺骗和明确讨论谎言的场合。它不等同于一般错误，也不宜仅因意见不同就用来评价他人。

etymology.historical_story: Kebohongan is formed within Malay from bohong using the productive circumfix ke-...-an. Its cultural interest lies in how Malay separates false content from deceptive action: kebohongan names falsehood or a lie, while pembohongan names the act of deceiving. Learning the pair reveals a useful distinction in journalism, public argument, and everyday judgments about honesty. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bohong)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 bohong“假的”：ke- 把它装进名词框，-an 收尾，kebohongan 就是“虚假这回事／谎言”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；词尾书写 b，在常见马来西亚读音中可实现为清化、不除阻的 [p̚]。

senses.zh_definition: 地球或其他旋转物体轴线的端点；地理上的极。
senses.en_definition: Either end of an axis, especially either geographical pole of the Earth.
senses.ms_definition: Hujung paksi atau gandar bumi atau sesuatu jasad.
senses.nuances: 用于地球时主要指北极或南极；地名写作 Kutub Utara、Kutub Selatan。

senses.zh_definition: 磁极；磁体两端磁作用较强的区域，或地球的磁极。
senses.en_definition: Either magnetic pole of a magnet or of the Earth.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian hujung magnet yang mempunyai daya tarikan paling kuat, atau kawasan kutub magnet bumi.
senses.nuances: 应区分磁极和地理极点；讨论地球磁场时，明确使用 magnet 或 magnetik。

collocations.en: the two poles of a magnet

senses.zh_definition: 电极或电路的正、负接点；词典也收录承载输入电流的导体或电路这一用法。
senses.en_definition: A positive or negative electrical pole or terminal; also, in the dictionary's technical wording, an incoming-current conductor or circuit.
senses.ms_definition: Punca positif atau negatif sesuatu litar elektrik; juga pengalir atau litar yang membawa arus masuk.
senses.nuances: 正负极与阳极、阴极不可在所有装置中直接画等号，应按具体电化学或电路情境判断。

senses.zh_definition: 仅见于 burung kutub 的鸟名，指词典所称的 burung tanau，一种拟啄木鸟。
senses.en_definition: In burung kutub, a kind of barbet also called burung tanau.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam nama burung kutub, sejenis burung yang juga disebut burung tanau.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 单列的同形异义词 kutub II，与“极”无语义关系；属于罕见鸟名，以下组合不声称具有高频。词典采用历史学名 Megalaima zeylanicus hodgsoni。各义依据：[DBP：kutub](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=kutub)。

collocations.zh: 称为 kutub 的拟啄木鸟

collocations.en: the call of the kutub barbet

dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan penyelidik itu mengkaji perubahan litupan ais di kawasan kutub.

etymology.historical_story: The pole sense of kutub comes from Arabic quṭb, meaning an axis, pivot, or pole. Malay gives it two syllables while retaining the Arabic-based Jawi spelling قطب. Its geographical, magnetic, and electrical uses share the image of a significant endpoint or pole; the separately recorded bird name should not be assigned this origin without evidence. [Sources: Malay etymology record](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/k/ku/kutub.html), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=kutub).

etymology.historical_story: Krishna comes from Sanskrit kṛṣṇa, meaning dark or black. The name identifies a major Hindu deity whose importance varies across religious traditions, and it also occurs as a personal name. Consequently, a Malaysian text containing Krishna may concern religion or an ordinary individual; the surrounding sentence must determine which interpretation applies.

etymology.historical_story: Koridor belongs to the international corridor word family, whose European history runs through French to Italian corridore, a long passage associated with running. Malay preserves the central image of connection. The same image also suits regional planning: a koridor ekonomi links places through coordinated development rather than through a hallway. See the [word-family history](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/koridor) and [Malaysian economic usage](https://www.mida.gov.my/ms/melabur-di-malaysia/fasilitasi-perniagaan/).

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚公文、考试及本地化界面采用 kod；引用印尼原文、标题或界面标签时，可保留 kode 并说明对应词。

etymology.historical_story: Kode and kod illustrate how closely related national languages can standardize different forms for corresponding concepts. Indonesian dictionaries record kode for signs, organized rules, and computing transformations, while Malaysian references use kod. For readers moving between the two countries, the final vowel becomes a useful regional clue. These sources establish the distinction, without establishing the word's precise borrowing history.

senses.zh_definition: 个人、群体、思想或事业重新活跃、觉醒并走向进步的过程；复兴；振兴。

senses.zh_definition: 宗教语境中死者重新获得生命或被使之复活的事件；复活。

senses.ms_definition: Peristiwa orang yang telah meninggal dunia dihidupkan kembali menurut kepercayaan agama.
senses.nuances: 伊斯兰语境常见 hari kebangkitan；基督宗教语境可指耶稣复活。具体教义由所属宗教决定。此义见 [DBP《Kamus Pelajar》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kebangkitan)。

etymology.historical_story: Built from bangkit, meaning to rise, kebangkitan turns an upward movement into an abstract event through ke-…-an. Its meanings connect renewed social energy, collective resistance, and religious resurrection. These are related images of rising again, rather than unrelated translations: the surrounding words tell readers whether a community, a movement, or the dead are rising. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kebangkitan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 bangkit 的“站起来”：精神站起来是振兴，人民站起来是起义，死者再起来是复活。

morphology.pattern_note: 首音节 ke 的 e 为央元音 /ə/；本词不拆作 ke- 加 tara。马来西亚部分口音将词尾 /a/ 读作 [ə]。

word_family.gloss: 明显的；ketara 的同义变体

senses.zh_definition: 明显的；清楚可见或容易察觉的，包括差异、变化、情绪或行为。
senses.en_definition: Clearly visible, readily noticeable, or evident.
senses.ms_definition: Nyata, terang kelihatan.
senses.nuances: 既可描述肉眼所见，也可描述可察觉的变化或差别。secara ketara 通常译为“明显地／显著地”，但本身不表示经过统计显著性检验。词义与词类依据 [DBP PRPM：ketara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=172780&keyword=ketara+)。

senses.zh_definition: 有形的；在资产、产品或文化遗产等术语中，指具有实体形态、可以直接感知的。
senses.en_definition: Tangible; having a physical form that can be directly perceived.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai bentuk fizikal yang dapat dilihat atau disentuh, khususnya dalam istilah seperti aset ketara dan warisan ketara.
senses.nuances: 这是特定术语中的用法，马来文释义为编写性说明。aset ketara 是“有形资产”，不能按一般义机械译成“明显的资产”；tak ketara 或 tidak ketara 在相应术语中表示“无形的”。参见 [DBP PRPM：ketara 的术语记录](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=ketara)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record ketara alongside kentara, linking both with clear visibility and obviousness. That relationship is documented, but it does not establish an earlier source language or a historical derivation from tara. The useful cultural thread is visibility: the same adjective can describe an exposed feeling, a noticeable change, or something physically perceptible in technical terminology.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ke.ta.ra 想成舞台灯光突然照亮一个细节：一眼就看出来，就是 ketara。画面联想，不是词源拆解。

senses.zh_definition: 饥饿；尤指因食物不足而挨饿或陷入严重饥饿的状态，亦可泛指饥荒造成的饥饿。
senses.en_definition: Hunger or starvation, especially from a lack of food.
senses.ms_definition: Kelaparan.
senses.nuances: 语气通常比日常 lapar 强。可指饥饿状态，也可直接用于谓语，如 mereka kebuluran，意为“他们在挨饿”。朋友间的 dah kebuluran 常是“饿坏了”的夸张说法。不能仅凭此词断定某地已被正式认定发生饥荒。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry explains kebuluran through kelaparan and records mati kebuluran for death from hunger. This establishes its semantic centre without establishing its earliest history. A useful cultural contrast is the movement between literal deprivation in accounts of hardship and emphatic personal hunger in conversation. The latter requires contextual interpretation, rather than a separate invented origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象空碗旁的人连喊四拍 ke.bu.lu.ran：不是普通“想吃”，而是“挨饿／饿坏了”。情景联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Khamis is an Arabic borrowing connected with the Arabic root for five. Its designation as the fifth day reflects a week counted from Sunday: Sunday first, Wednesday fourth, Thursday fifth. This explains why the dictionary's numbering differs from calendars that place Monday at the beginning of the week. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=khamis), [Arabic lexical database](https://wold.clld.org/word/92181432339901785-1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 kha-mis：把 /x/ 想成轻轻的气流声，再记“Rabu 后接 Khamis”：星期三后就是星期四。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整借词处理，不把 -asi 拆作本词的马来语后缀。DBP 收录 mengkombinasikan；此借词派生形式保留词首 k。

senses.nuances: 强调多个要素共同组成整体，可用于颜色、方法、技巧、材料或人员搭配，不要求发生物理混合。一般语境中常可换用 gabungan。参见 [DBP 词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kombinasi)。

etymology.historical_story: Kombinasi has the shape of an international European loanword, comparable with English combination and Dutch combinatie. Its everyday Malay meaning is firmly established as a joining of elements. These similarities do not by themselves identify the immediate donor language, so a specific borrowing route is left unassigned here. See [DBP's entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kombinasi).

word_family.gloss: 成瘾者；须由搭配确定具体对象

senses.zh_definition: 处于上瘾、难以摆脱对某种物质或活动的强烈渴求的状态；也可夸张地表示迷上某事。
senses.en_definition: To be addicted to something or experience a compelling habitual craving for it.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam keadaan ketagih; menderita ketagih.
senses.nuances: 这里按状态谓语用法处理。用于 dadah、rokok 等时语气较重；用于歌曲、阅读等时可为夸张表达，不自动构成医学诊断。词义依据 [DBP：tagih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tagih)。

collocations.en: be addicted to playing video games

senses.zh_definition: 对某种事物产生的强烈、反复的依赖或渴求；上瘾的状态。
senses.en_definition: Addiction or a persistent habitual craving for something.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau rasa ketagih akan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 名词用法见 Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua，可作 mengatasi、mengurangkan 等动词的宾语。与 penagih「成瘾者」区别：ketagihan 指状态，不指人。参见 [DBP：tagih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tagih)。

etymology.historical_story: Ketagihan belongs to the tagih word family. Malay dictionaries distinguish craving and habitual attachment from another tagih sense involving demands for payment. Their examples range from opium and cigarettes to newspapers, showing that the craving sense can describe both harmful dependence and an enthusiastic everyday habit. This is a semantic distinction, not proof of a shared historical origin. [DBP: tagih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tagih)

morphology.pattern_note: 环缀 ke-...-an 将表示自由、独立的 merdeka 转为状态名词；词根保持不变，词尾 a 与后缀 an 分属两个音节。资料包的 syllables 为 null；DBP 标示 ke.mer.dé.ka.an。

etymology.historical_story: Kemerdekaan combines merdeka with the Malay state-forming circumfix ke-...-an. Merdeka is traced to Sanskrit maharddhika, associated with prosperity and power. In modern Malaysian usage, its derivative names the freedom achieved through independence and repeatedly heard in national commemorations. The history connects an inherited word with a particularly powerful modern political meaning. [Historical account](https://www.mohe.gov.my/en/broadcast/media-coverage/hayati-erti-merdeka-seiring-perkembangan-pendidikan-negara)

morphology.pattern_note: 外来地名，整词记忆；末尾 s 不是马来语词缀或复数标记。规范书写为 Kansas。音标采用英语地名读音，未提供经核实的爪夷文拼写。

etymology.historical_story: Kansas takes its name from the Kansa or Kanza people, also known as the Kaw. The Kaw Nation connects its name with the south wind and explains that European traders recorded several spellings. Remembering this origin links the modern state name to a living Indigenous nation and its enduring cultural heritage. [Source: Kaw Nation](https://www.kawnation.gov/the-kanza-people/).

morphology.pattern_note: ke-…-an 构成名词，表示卓越状态或决出冠军的比赛；词根不发生辅音变化，词尾 a 与后缀 -an 的 a 保留。

etymology.historical_story: Kejuaraan illustrates a productive Malay pattern: the circumfix ke-…-an turns juara, 'champion', into a noun associated with excellence or a championship competition. The supplied dictionary records both meanings. The connection is memorable: the quality associated with a champion and the contest that identifies one share a single derived form. This is a morphological account, not a claim about juara's ultimate origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: juara 是“冠军”；给它套上 ke-…-an，就想到“冠军级实力”或“决出冠军的赛事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示片状物或碎片的名词。词根末尾 /ŋ/ 在接元音后成为下一音节的声母：/kə.piŋ/ → /kə.pi.ŋan/；ng 表示单个鼻音。

senses.zh_definition: 从较大物体破裂或分离出来的小而薄的部分；碎片、碎薄片。
senses.en_definition: A small, thin fragment broken or separated from a larger object.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian kecil dan nipis yang terpisah daripada sesuatu benda akibat pecah atau terbelah.
senses.nuances: 强调薄片状碎块，常用于玻璃等材料；一般碎块可用 pecahan，更细小的碎屑常用 serpihan。kepingan 本身不标示复数。参见 [DBP：kepingan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=kepingan)。

senses.zh_definition: 形状扁平而薄的物体或材料；薄片、板片，不一定由破裂形成。
senses.en_definition: A flat, thin piece or sheet of material, whether intact or cut to shape.
senses.ms_definition: Benda atau bahan yang berbentuk pipih dan nipis, seperti getah atau logam.
senses.nuances: 此义不含“已经破碎”的必然含义。kepingan 是名词；keping 常作量词，因此 dua keping logam 表示“两片金属”，kepingan logam 则表示“金属薄片”。

etymology.historical_story: Kepingan grows transparently from keping, a Malay word associated with flat, thin things and their counting. Adding -an produces a noun for such a piece or fragment. Dictionary examples include broken glass and smoked rubber sheets, connecting household experience with material processing. The same shape, rather than breakage alone, unites its two principal meanings. Sources: [DBP: keping](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=keping), [DBP: kepingan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=kepingan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 keping 的“片”形：keping + -an 就是“片状的东西”。完整的是薄片，摔碎的是碎片；共同点是扁、薄。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入将 kudengar 列为独立词根，此处依据实际构词校正为 dengar。ku- 是 aku 的前附着形式，并非派生前缀；与动词连写，不发生鼻音同化。Bunyi itu kudengar 中，ku- 标示第一人称施事。

senses.zh_definition: 我听说；我从别人的话语或消息中得知。

senses.nuances: 须由 nasihat、pesan 等宾语及上下文确定；“听取意见”不一定等于“照办”。见 [DBP：dengar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=dengar)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: ku- 与 aku 相连，适合亲近关系、内心独白和文学叙述；面向长辈、客户或正式会议，通常改用 saya dengar 或 saya mendengar。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 转述未核实消息时可加 belum pasti 或 perlu disahkan。kudengar 不应写成 ku dengar；在正式被动结构中，所听对象通常放在前面，如 perkara itu kudengar sendiri。

etymology.historical_story: Kudengar is a grammatical combination rather than an indivisible inherited headword. Its opening ku- is the bound form of aku, while dengar supplies the meaning hear. DBP explicitly requires the combined spelling. This compact construction remains useful in narrative and verse: suara yang kudengar means the voice I heard, with the hearer built into the verb phrase. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kudengar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ku- 是“我”，dengar 是“听”：kudengar＝“我听见”。看到 yang kudengar，就读成“我听到的”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆分为 kon- 与 voi；末尾 oi 在同一音节中构成双元音。

etymology.historical_story: Konvoi corresponds to English convoy, whose history reaches back through French to the idea of travelling together under escort. French convoyer originally expressed accompanying and protecting travellers. Malay dictionary senses preserve both sides of that relationship: the protecting warships and the protected ships, alongside the familiar modern road convoy. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/convoy); [French Academy](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9C4121); [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=konvoi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: konvoi 与英语 convoy 读形相近：想象几辆车排队一起走；加 ber-，berkonvoi 就是“结队同行”。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将 lengkap 名词化。词根末尾 /p/ 在元音起首的 -an 前成为下一音节的声母，因此分为 ke.leng.ka.pan；ng 表示单一辅音 /ŋ/。

word_family.gloss: 补充物；补足成分；语法补语

senses.zh_definition: 完整、齐全的状态；所需部分俱备。

senses.en_definition: A fleet or naval force, in classical Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Melayu klasik, angkatan laut atau armada kapal.

etymology.historical_story: Kelengkapan is transparently formed from lengkap, meaning complete, with the nominal circumfix ke-...-an. Its dictionary senses connect completeness with things made ready for use. A particularly revealing classical meaning is a naval fleet: ships and their preparations understood as an assembled whole. Modern speakers more often encounter the word through office supplies, cooking utensils, and other equipment.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lengkap＝齐全；ke-...-an 把它变成名词：既可指“齐全的状态”，也可指“让事情齐全的装备”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；这里是 kilogram 或 kilometer 的简称，没有马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 公斤；千克，等于一千克的质量单位，是 kilogram 的简称。
senses.en_definition: A kilogram; a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.
senses.ms_definition: Kilogram, iaitu seribu gram.
senses.nuances: 在菜市场购物、称重和谈论体重时常见。通常接在数量后面，如 dua kilo。正式计量文件宜写 kilogram 或 kg；日常虽常用来谈重量，技术上表示质量。

senses.zh_definition: 公里；千米，等于一千米的长度单位，是 kilometer 的简称。
senses.en_definition: A kilometre; a unit of distance equal to one thousand metres.
senses.ms_definition: Kilometer, iaitu seribu meter.
senses.nuances: 主要见于谈论路程的口语，须依语境与公斤义区分。正式路线说明及技术报告宜写 kilometer 或 km。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向摊主购买东西时可说 Saya hendak sekilo ikan, boleh?；加上 tolong 或语气温和的 ya 更显客气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 日常购物与朋友聊天自然适用。报价、配送或路线沟通中，应明确是公斤还是公里，避免仅写数字加 kilo 造成歧义。

etymology.historical_story: The international metric element kilo- comes from Greek and means ‘thousand’. Malay uses kilo independently as a shortened form of kilogram and kilometer. The same short word therefore connects two everyday experiences: weighing produce at a market and describing a journey. Context supplies the missing unit, distinguishing a bag of rice from a stretch of road.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ki-lo，记住两个零件：秤上是公斤，路上是公里；完整单位都含 kilo-，表示一千。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包中的根词标记；未核实其为马来语词根。英语读音中的 oo 表示 /uː/，不按两个马来语 o 分读。

senses.zh_definition: 英语非正式用语：想法或行为古怪、荒唐的人；怪人。
senses.en_definition: An eccentric person, especially one whose ideas or behaviour seem absurd.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris tidak formal, orang yang dianggap pelik atau mempunyai idea atau kelakuan yang tidak masuk akal.
senses.nuances: 未核实为正式马来语词。这里解释英语义项；马来语定义为编写的对译说明，不是 DBP 释文。语气可带嘲讽或贬义，也不是医学诊断。以下搭配是马来语对应表达，不是已证实的 kook 马来语搭配。见 [Merriam-Webster：kook](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/kook)。

collocations.en: regarded as eccentric; considered a kook

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合解释英文引语或分析人物语气。马来语正式文本可按语境使用 orang yang pelik 或描述具体行为，避免无说明地插入英语标签。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接称别人 kook 容易显得轻蔑。对不熟悉的人、长辈或同事，应具体描述其言行。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合解释英文引语或分析人物语气。马来语正式文本可按语境使用 orang yang pelik 或描述具体行为，避免无说明地插入英语标签。

etymology.historical_story: English kook developed through shortening and alteration of cuckoo, a bird name also used figuratively for an eccentric person. Merriam-Webster records kook from 1922. Its history helps explain the mocking undertone: the word labels a person through an image of oddness rather than offering a neutral description. See [Merriam-Webster: kook](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/kook).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kook /kuːk/ 与英语 cuckoo 的“古怪”联想相连；这是词义记忆线索，不是马来语构词。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 构成表示状态、结果或相关事物的名词，词根无辅音交替；末尾重新划分为 lu.san。输入将 kelulusan 标为词根，与其可分析构词及 DBP 的 lulus 派生词条不符，此处据此更正。

word_family.gloss: 毕业生；通过相关考试者

etymology.historical_story: Kelulusan is transparently formed from lulus with the Malay circumfix ke-...-an. The root covers physical passage as well as passing examinations and receiving approval. Passing through a checkpoint provides a useful analogy for these meanings, although it is not a documented historical sequence. Education adds the familiar sense of an attained qualification. See [DBP: lulus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lulus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lulus 是“过关”；ke-...-an 把它变成名词：考试过关是及格，申请过关是批准，读书取得的资格是学历。

morphology.pattern_note: 形容词 abadi 加环缀 ke-...-an，构成表示状态的抽象名词；ke- 中的 e 读 /ə/，词根保持不变。元音交界处可出现声门塞音或轻微滑音。

etymology.historical_story: The base abadi is recorded as an Arabic loan meaning everlasting. Malay adds its own circumfix ke-...-an to turn that quality into an abstract noun. The resulting word connects expressions of enduring love and religious eternity with scientific terminology, where keabadian tenaga refers to energy conservation rather than endless life.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks konyol with Jk, identifying a Jakarta usage connection. DBP explains that this abbreviation refers to Jakarta Malay or Betawi usage. The label gives regional context, rather than a complete borrowing history. Its recorded meanings concern foolishness and improper conduct; the expression mati konyol additionally describes a needless death.

etymology.historical_story: Kentut belongs to an inherited Austronesian vocabulary for bodily functions. Comparative scholarship connects it with reconstructed *qetut; the exact historical sound changes should not be confused with modern Malay affixation. The association also appears in plant naming: daun kentut refers to a plant whose smell invites comparison with intestinal gas. See [Nothofer, Pengantar Etimologi](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/26597/1/Bernd%20Nothofer_Pengantar%20Etimologi%20lengkap%20pdf.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把末音节 tut 想成一声短促的“噗”，记住 kentut＝屁／放屁；这只是声音联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Karier belongs to the vocabulary used to describe a working life as something sustained over time. DBP defines it through long-term work or professional activity and gives kerjaya as its synonym. This makes the cultural distinction memorable: a job can be one position, while a karier connects work across a longer life journey. Its precise borrowing route is not established here. [DBP: karier](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=146196&keyword=karier)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karier 与英语 career 连起来记：不是一天的工作，而是一条持续发展的职业道路。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 构成使动及物动词，词根不变；ku.at 中 u 与 a 分属两个音节。kuatkan 可直接用于祈使句，普通主动陈述句通常用 menguatkan。数据包的 قوات 是 kuat 的 Jawi；完整 kuatkan 为 قواتکن。[DBP：menguatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menguatkan+1)

senses.zh_definition: 使身体、物体、结构或连接变得更有力、更牢固或更坚韧。
senses.en_definition: Make a body, object, structure or connection stronger or more secure.
senses.ms_definition: Jadikan badan, benda, binaan atau ikatan lebih bertenaga, kukuh atau teguh.
senses.nuances: 这里是带 -kan 的动词，不是形容词 kuat。祈使句可说 Kuatkan ikatan itu；主动陈述通常说 Dia menguatkan ikatan itu。[DBP：kuat 与 menguatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menguatkan+1)

senses.zh_definition: 增强勇气、意志、信念或信心；使某种判断获得更强支持。
senses.en_definition: Bolster courage, resolve, belief or confidence, or give stronger support to a conclusion.
senses.ms_definition: Teguhkan semangat, keazaman, kepercayaan atau keyakinan, atau tambah sokongan terhadap sesuatu pendapat.
senses.nuances: kuatkan semangat 常用于鼓励；kuatkan hati 强调鼓起勇气或坚定内心。涉及论证时，可表示用证据加强主张。[DBP：menguatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menguatkan+1)

senses.zh_definition: 使声音更响，或使压力、作用等更强。
senses.en_definition: Increase the loudness of a sound or the intensity of pressure or force.
senses.ms_definition: Jadikan bunyi lebih nyaring atau tingkatkan kekuatan tekanan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: kuatkan suara 可表示说大声一点；kuatkan bunyi 可表示调高设备音量。此处 kuat 指响度或强度，不涉及身体力量。[DBP：menguatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menguatkan+1)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: kuatkan semangat 适合鼓励，但安慰悲伤者时宜先倾听，避免只说 Kuatkan semangat 而显得催促对方坚强。调大公共场所设备音量前，也应顾及旁人。

etymology.historical_story: Kuatkan shows how Malay grammar turns a quality into a practical instruction. Kuat describes strength, firmness or loudness; adding -kan asks someone to bring that quality about. The same pattern works with muscles, resolve and sound. In everyday Malaysian speech, a short request to raise the volume therefore shares its grammatical structure with an appeal to stay courageous.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kuat＝强，-kan＝使它变成这样：肌肉变强、意志变强、声音变强，都可以用 kuatkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节整词，不拆成词缀。现代常通过 kit + 用途或内容名称组成复合词；下列词族成员为复合表达。

senses.zh_definition: 组装套件；预先配齐、可组装成某种物品的一套零部件。
senses.en_definition: A set of parts supplied ready for assembly into an object.
senses.ms_definition: Set bahagian-bahagian yang sedia untuk dipasang.
senses.nuances: 这是输入所引《Kamus Dewan》的核心释义。强调配套零件及组装用途，不仅指装东西的盒子。[DBP：kit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kit)

senses.zh_definition: 为某项用途配备的一套工具、用品或材料；工具包、用品套装。
senses.en_definition: A set of tools, supplies, or materials collected for a particular purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Set alat, bahan atau kelengkapan yang dihimpunkan untuk kegunaan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 用于急救、教学、维修等现代场景；成套用品不一定需要组装。此义是现代用途表达中的常见用法，应与狭义的组装零件套件区分。

senses.zh_definition: 旧时固定表达 rumah kit 中的组成部分，指售卖鸦片的房屋或店铺。
senses.en_definition: In the historical expression rumah kit, a house or shop selling opium.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan rumah kit: rumah atau kedai tempat menjual candu.
senses.nuances: 限于历史表达 rumah kit，不宜把独立的 kit 普遍解释成鸦片店。相关 rumah 词条也记载吸食鸦片场所的用法；此处依据输入 kit 词条保留售卖义。该旧表达不能按现代“套件”义理解。[DBP：kit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kit)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 急救包、学习套装等可正常使用 kit。rumah kit 属于历史词汇，适合文献或历史讨论，不应用来称呼现代普通商店。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 现代套件义语体中性，适合采购、教学和日常交流；说明具体用途有助于避免歧义。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 急救包、学习套装等可正常使用 kit。rumah kit 属于历史词汇，适合文献或历史讨论，不应用来称呼现代普通商店。

etymology.historical_story: Modern kit corresponds to English kit and names a collection prepared for assembly or a particular task. Malay places the purpose after it, as in kit pembelajaran. The dictionary also preserves rumah kit, an older expression associated with opium premises. That historical expression requires separate explanation rather than interpretation through the modern equipment sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kit 想成“一套齐”：零件齐了能组装，用品齐了能办事；rumah kit 则整组记作旧时鸦片店。

morphology.formula: ke + depan → ke depan；kedepan 为非规范连写
morphology.pattern_note: 这里的 ke 是独立介词，不是前缀，须与 depan 分开书写。IPA 按规范短语 ke depan 标示；输入中将 kedepan 视为词根的分析不适用于这个方向短语。

senses.zh_definition: 向前；往前方或前面的位置移动。规范写法为 ke depan。
senses.en_definition: Forward; towards the front. The standard Malay spelling is ke depan.
senses.ms_definition: Ke arah bahagian hadapan; bergerak maju atau mara.
senses.nuances: 此处按整个短语的方向状语功能标为 adverb；马来语结构分析则是介词短语。ke depan 表示移动方向，di depan 表示所在位置。正式例句及搭配采用规范分写形式。[DBP：depan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=depan)；[DBP：介词 ke 的分写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=datang+ke+hadapan)

senses.zh_definition: 往后；今后；朝向未来。规范写法为 ke depan。
senses.en_definition: Ahead in time; henceforth or into the future.
senses.ms_definition: Pada waktu yang berikutnya; selanjutnya atau seterusnya.
senses.nuances: 这是空间方向向时间概念的引申。马来西亚正式行文也常用 pada masa hadapan 或 selepas ini，以明确表达未来或此后。[DBP：depan 的时间义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=depan)

etymology.historical_story: This expression combines the directional preposition ke with depan, meaning the front. Malay also uses depan in expressions about the future, allowing physical forward movement to suggest progress through time. Kedepan is a spelling error for this phrase, not evidence of a separate root or a distinct historical borrowing. [DBP: depan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=depan)

senses.zh_definition: 见面；遇见；与某人相会，包括约定会面或偶然碰见。
senses.en_definition: To meet someone or come across someone.
senses.ms_definition: Bertemu atau berjumpa dengan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标注 Jk，即雅加达马来语来源或用法；《Kamus Pelajar》也收录“见面”义。马来西亚一般正式表达宜用 bertemu 或 berjumpa，不宜把 ketemu 教作全国通用的日常首选。[DBP：ketemu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ketemu)；[DBP：Jk 标签说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jk)。

collocations.en: to run into an old friend

senses.zh_definition: 找到；被找到；寻获某人或某物，具体主动或结果关系由句式决定。
senses.en_definition: To find or be found, depending on the construction.
senses.ms_definition: Ditemukan atau dijumpai; terdapat.
senses.nuances: 此义对应输入 DBP 的 terdapat；口语中常见于否定寻找结果，如 belum ketemu。马来西亚正式叙述宜根据主语和语态使用 menemui、ditemui 或 ditemukan。[DBP：ketemu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ketemu)。

senses.zh_definition: 在固定说法 ketemu akal 中表示说得通、合乎情理。
senses.en_definition: In the fixed expression ketemu akal, to make sense or be reasonable.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan ketemu akal, diterima akal atau masuk akal.
senses.nuances: 固定表达，不表示“找到一个主意”；马来西亚日常和正式表达均以 masuk akal 更容易理解。[DBP：ketemu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ketemu)。

etymology.historical_story: Ketemu belongs to a regional network of words associated with meeting and finding. An Indonesian government etymological dictionary connects it with Javanese ketemu and temu. Kamus Dewan labels its Malay entry Jk, identifying Jakarta usage. These references explain its regional associations without making ke- a freely productive modern Malay prefix here. [Indonesian etymological dictionary](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/23879/1/KAMUS%20ETIMOLOGI%20BAHASA%20INDONESIA.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ketemu 和 bertemu 并排记：都能联想到“见面”，ketemu 多一层印尼地域色彩。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为整体专名处理；源语名称的内部结构不是马来语词缀。IPA 为便于马来语学习者使用的近似读音，非已核实的 DBP 标音。

senses.en_definition: Koh-i-Noor, a famous diamond associated with South Asian dynasties and the British Crown Jewels.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi sebutir berlian terkenal yang mempunyai kaitan sejarah dengan dinasti di Asia Selatan dan permata kebesaran diraja Britain.

etymology.historical_story: Koh-i-Noor is a Persian name meaning Mountain of Light. The diamond passed through several South Asian and neighbouring courts before the East India Company took it from the deposed Duleep Singh under treaty terms in 1849. Its name therefore evokes both brilliance and imperial conquest; colourful stories about its naming should be distinguished from documented events. [Meaning: V&A](https://www.vam.ac.uk/blog/caring-for-our-collections/henry-cole-and-the-koh-i-noor-diamond); [history: Historic Royal Palaces](https://www.hrp.org.uk/tower-of-london/history-and-stories/the-crown-jewels/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Koh-i-Noor 与“光之山”绑定：想象一颗钻石闪出整座山的光。这个画面帮助记住专名，不是马来语构词分析。

morphology.pattern_note: 单纯词，无词缀音变；首音节的 e 读央元音 /ə/。词族中的 kera-kera 是完整重叠式。

word_family.gloss: 多只猴子；猴群，完整重叠式

senses.zh_definition: 猴，尤指通常具有长尾的猕猴；在马来西亚常指长尾猕猴。
senses.en_definition: A monkey, especially a macaque, commonly the long-tailed macaque in Malaysian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis monyet yang biasanya berekor panjang.
senses.nuances: 日常动物名称，不能直接等同于英语 ape。输入词典采用旧学名 Macacus cynomolgus；马来西亚野生动物部门使用 Macaca fascicularis 指长尾猕猴。参见 [DBP：kera](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kera)及 [PERHILITAN：长尾猕猴管理资料](https://files.wildlife.gov.my/wildlife-wp-media/2025/09/13082208/PelanPengurusanKeraBermasalah.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于若干猴类名称中的通称成分，具体所指由完整名称决定。
senses.en_definition: A naming element used for various kinds of monkeys.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan bagi berbagai-bagai jenis monyet apabila digunakan dalam nama binatang tersebut.
senses.nuances: 这是动物名称中的扩展用法，不表示所有含 kera 的组合都指同一种猕猴。kera jambul 是词典例项。参见 [DBP：kera](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kera)。

senses.zh_definition: 仅见于固定鸟名 burung kera，指又称 burung sanuk 的一种鸟；与猴类义分属不同词条。
senses.en_definition: In burung kera, a bird also known in Malay as burung sanuk.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam nama burung kera, sejenis burung yang juga dinamakan burung sanuk.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 另列的同形词 kera II，仅限鸟名语境，不能将普通 kera 自动理解为鸟。词典列出的学名为 Rhopodytes tristis longicaudatus；此处不将该历史分类名称冒充为经核定的现行分类。以下为识别该罕见义的组合，并非高频搭配。参见 [DBP：kera II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kera)。

collocations.zh: 又称 burung sanuk 的鸟

collocations.en: burung kera, also called burung sanuk

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverbial tradition gives kera a life beyond animal naming. Sekangkang kera evokes a very small patch of land, while bagai kera mendapat bunga describes receiving something one cannot appreciate or use. These expressions document cultural associations with monkeys; they do not establish the word's ultimate linguistic origin. See [DBP: kera](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kera).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ke-ra，想象一只猴子伸手抓食物；再用 anak kera（幼猴）把声音和形象连起来。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 词首 ke- 属于词根，不能拆作前缀。派生 mengepung 时，meN- 在 k 前实现为 meng-，并使词根首音 k 脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 从四周包围人、动物或地点，使其受困或无法逃离。
senses.en_definition: To surround someone or something so as to prevent escape.
senses.ms_definition: Mengelilingi orang, haiwan atau tempat supaya tidak dapat melepaskan diri.
senses.nuances: 标准陈述句通常用 mengepung；kepung 可用于祈使句及口语省略前缀的表达。含围堵、限制行动之意，比单纯的 kelilingi 更强。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=kepung)

senses.zh_definition: 围成一圈站立或坐下；以环状位置围着某物。

senses.ms_definition: Berdiri atau duduk dalam bulatan mengelilingi sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 本义通常体现为派生形式 berkepung，不必含敌意或封锁意味。不能把标准语的 duduk berkepung 随意改成 duduk kepung。

senses.zh_definition: 某些龙脑香科乔木的马来名称，见于 kepung hantu 和 kepung labu。
senses.en_definition: A tree name occurring in kepung hantu and kepung labu.
senses.ms_definition: Nama pokok yang disebut kepung hantu atau kepung labu.
senses.nuances: 这是与“包围”分立的同形植物名。DBP 所列学名分别为 Shorea macroptera 和 Shorea rigida；此处保留该词典的分类名称。这两个搭配属于植物名称，使用频率低于动词搭配。

etymology.historical_story: DBP illustrates this word family with an older account of a fort being surrounded by Bugis forces, alongside peaceful scenes of people sitting in a circle. These examples reveal a shared spatial image: a ring around a centre. The dictionary also records kepung as a tree name, but that separate entry does not establish a common origin. [DBP entries](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=kepung)

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆；这里按马来语方言中对应 kuih 的形式处理。[ku.we] 是有记录的地方读音，不代表全国统一读音。

senses.en_definition: A regional Malay form of kuih: a small cake, confection, or snack.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk dialek bagi kuih, iaitu makanan ringan atau penganan.
senses.nuances: 不能把这个拼写直接标为马来西亚标准词形。DBP 方言材料记录了 kue 及其食品搭配；正式马来西亚马来语通常写 kuih。本条按地方马来语解释，不据此判断输入一定来自哪个地区或语言。[DBP 方言例句](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=ja)、[DBP 标准词条 kuih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=kuih)。

etymology.historical_story: Regional food vocabulary preserves differences that standard spelling can hide. DBP records kue in dialect examples and food names, while its standard dictionary uses kuih. These records establish a regional relationship, but do not establish when this particular spelling arose. The useful cultural connection is the shared world of small cakes and snacks, rather than an invented origin story. [DBP dialect records](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=kuih).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把地方口语 kue 和标准语 kuih 配成一盘糕点：说法有地方差异，正式写作认准 kuih。

word_family.gloss: 僵硬；拘谨；表达生硬的状态

senses.zh_definition: 僵硬的；难以弯曲或活动的，尤指身体、肢体或肌肉。
senses.en_definition: Stiff or rigid; unable to bend or move freely, especially of the body or its parts.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak boleh dilentur; kejang; kejur.
senses.nuances: 强调缺乏柔韧性或活动能力；keras 更侧重硬度。也可描写人因惊恐等原因僵住，但单凭这个词不能判断具体原因。[DBP：kaku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=kaku)

senses.zh_definition: 举止拘谨、不自然的；语言、表演或艺术表现生硬、不流畅或缺乏生气的。
senses.en_definition: Awkward, stilted, or lacking natural movement, fluency, or expression.
senses.ms_definition: Canggung atau tidak lancar pada gerak-geri, gaya dan bahasa; kurang hidup pada lakonan atau karya seni.
senses.nuances: 这是身体僵硬义的比喻用法。形容人的表现时通常针对当下举止，不必然表示其个性冷漠或能力不足。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records a useful bridge between material and intellectual activity: kutip gathers fallen objects, but also gathers donations and extracts words from writing. These meanings share the image of taking individual items into a collection. This is a semantic connection, rather than a documented chronology of origin; the available evidence does not establish a deeper historical derivation.

etymology.historical_story: Klaus has a documented history as a German shortened form of Nikolaus that became an independent given name. In Malay writing, that personal name retains its capital initial. Lowercase klaus also appears where Malaysian documents otherwise use klausa. These are separate editorial situations: a borrowed personal name and an inconsistent spelling of a common noun, rather than one established Malay word with a single origin. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/klaus), [documentary example](https://www.mbsbbank.com/sites/default/files/inline-files/Notice%20Revision%20T%26C_031024%5B2%5D.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Malay kempen is a borrowing of English campaign. Its modern public-facing meaning is easy to recognize in election appeals, health education and environmental initiatives: many coordinated actions serve one objective. Remembering that shared purpose helps distinguish a kempen from an isolated announcement, even when both use posters or public messages. See [Malay etymological entry](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/k/ke/kempen.html).

etymology.historical_story: Kaunter is an adapted borrowing of English counter. DBP's terminology guidelines explicitly pair counter with kaunter, illustrating how an English ou pronounced as a diphthong becomes Malay au. The word now names familiar service points in Malaysian institutions and shops. It also has a separate financial meaning for a stock listed on an exchange. [DBP spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf)

word_family.gloss: 对人、动物或植物实施检疫隔离

senses.zh_definition: 为防止传染病传播，将疑似携带病原体的人、动物或植物与外界分开的检疫隔离措施或期限。
senses.en_definition: Preventive separation, or a period of separation, of people, animals, or plants suspected of carrying an infectious disease.
senses.ms_definition: Tempoh pengasingan khas bagi orang, haiwan atau tumbuhan yang disyaki membawa penyakit untuk mencegah penularannya.
senses.nuances: 重点在预防传播，并不表示对象已经确诊。常见于公共卫生、动物检疫和植物检疫；口语 boleh kuarantin、kena kuarantin 中可能直接作动词性表达，正式主动及物动词用 mengkuarantin。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kuarantin)。

etymology.historical_story: The international word behind kuarantin carries a memory of ships waiting offshore. Its history leads to Italian quaranta, meaning forty, and European port practices requiring vessels to wait forty days before landing during plague outbreaks. The historical number survives in the word, although quarantine periods are not inherently forty days long. [CDC word history](https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/19/2/ET-1902_article)。

etymology.historical_story: The international term clan is associated with Gaelic clann, meaning children or offspring. Scottish historical usage connected it with named groups united under a chief. This background helps explain the modern association with shared descent. The precise borrowing route into Malay klan is not established by the supplied packet and should not be assumed. [Historical dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost/clan).

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names traces Kapoor to a Punjabi personal name meaning camphor, connected with Sanskrit karpūra. An inherited name can preserve an old lexical association without carrying that meaning in ordinary conversation. In Malay, identifying someone as Kapoor therefore names a person or family; it does not translate their surname as a substance. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/kapoor?geo-lang=en-US).

senses.nuances: 强调生活处境，而非单项任务的难度。kesukaran kewangan 不必然表示长期贫穷，也可指暂时资金紧张；dalam kesukaran 的具体程度须由语境判断。

etymology.historical_story: The formation of kesukaran illustrates a productive Malay pattern: ke- and -an turn a quality into a condition or experience. Sukar describes something difficult; kesukaran names the difficulty itself. Its dictionary meanings connect demanding tasks with material hardship, allowing one word to describe both a difficult undertaking and the strain of living with insufficient resources.

etymology.historical_story: Rather than requiring a speculative ancient origin, kekecewaan can be understood through productive Malay word formation. The adjective kecewa describes disappointed feelings; the circumfix ke-...-an turns that quality into an abstract noun. This allows speakers to name, discuss, and express disappointment as an experience, rather than merely describe somebody as disappointed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kecewa“失望的”放进 ke-...-an 这个名词框，就得到 kekecewaan“一份失望的感受”。

etymology.historical_story: Kutukan is formed from kutuk with the noun-forming suffix -an. The dictionary connects it with both curses and abusive denunciation, explaining why it appears in supernatural stories as well as accounts of public outrage. Its structure belongs to the kutuk family, not to kutu, the unrelated word for a louse. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=kutuk).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kutuk 是咒骂，接上 -an 就把咒骂变成名词 kutukan；盯住中间那个 k，别误拆成 kutu（虱子）。

etymology.historical_story: A university study of dialogue in the film This Is Pilah records koba as a Negeri Sembilan word meaning beritahu. That evidence establishes a regional use, but does not establish its ultimate etymology. Its value for learners is cultural: recognising a local verb can make regional conversation easier to follow. etymology.historical_story: Keistimewaan illustrates how Malay makes an abstract noun from istimewa, special. The surrounding ke- and -an turn a quality into something that can be described, compared, or granted. This connects two familiar settings: explaining what makes a traditional dish distinctive and describing benefits reserved for members. Both uses centre on something receiving special distinction.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 istimewa“特别”放进 ke-…-an 的名词框：特别在哪里，就是 keistimewaan；特别给你的待遇，也是它。

morphology.pattern_note: ke- 的 e 读 /ə/，esok 的 e 读 /e/，两者分属相邻音节。词尾加 -an 后，k 通常成为后一音节的声母；词典另列保留喉塞音的读法 [kə.e.soʔ.kan]。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 报告行程时先交代参照日期，避免读者不清楚“第二天”是哪一天。不要把 keesokan harinya 一律理解成说话者的“明天”。

etymology.historical_story: Keesokan is built from esok with the Malay circumfix ke-...-an. Its familiar narrative setting is keesokan harinya, which moves a story forward by one day. The useful cultural connection is storytelling itself: the expression follows the narrator's calendar, allowing a remembered journey, a news report, or a future itinerary to advance without repeatedly naming dates.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: esok＝明天；keesokan harinya＝故事里“那一天的明天”，也就是次日。两个 e 分开念：kə-e。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于词尾的第三人称领属或回指附着词，严格说不是派生后缀；suffix 为本结构的近似分类。ny 表示 /ɲ/，词根不变。headword.jawi 保留数据包的词根写法；完整 kulitnya 可写作 کوليتڽ，音节为 ku.lit.nya。

senses.nuances: -nya 不区分性别，所指由上下文确定。领属分析参照 [DBP：代词与附着词](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/02/20/12033/)。

senses.zh_definition: 它的果皮、树皮、蛋壳等外层。

senses.ms_definition: Lapisan luar buah, pokok, telur atau benda yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 按指称对象选择中文和英文译法。基本义项参照 [DBP：kulit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kulit)。

senses.zh_definition: 它的兽皮，或其所用的皮革材料。
senses.en_definition: Its hide, or the leather used in it.

senses.en_definition: The surface or superficial aspects of something.
senses.ms_definition: Aspek luaran atau pengetahuan yang tidak mendalam tentang sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，常与 sahaja 连用，强调理解不深入。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: -nya 需要清楚的上下文。多人或多件物品同时出现时，用 kulit bayi itu、kulit mangga itu 等完整短语可避免歧义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈皮肤健康或物体外皮通常中性；评论他人肤色、疤痕或外貌时应注意隐私与感受，避免把肤色与价值高低挂钩。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: -nya 需要清楚的上下文。多人或多件物品同时出现时，用 kulit bayi itu、kulit mangga itu 等完整短语可避免歧义。

etymology.historical_story: Kulit belongs to an old Austronesian vocabulary of outer coverings. Comparative evidence links Malay kulit with related forms meaning skin, bark, peel and hide across the language family, reconstructed as Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *kulit. Adding -nya makes an ordinary referring expression rather than a separate lexical root: the surrounding conversation supplies whose skin or which object's covering is meant. See [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-w_k.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kulit 是“皮”，-nya 是“他／她／它的”：kulitnya 就是“那个人或东西的皮”。看前文决定是谁、哪种皮。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆作马来语词缀；第二音节的 e 为 é /e/。未确认常用派生词，故不补造词族。

senses.zh_definition: 卡特尔；生产者或经营者为控制价格、供应或市场竞争而组成的联合组织。
senses.en_definition: An association of producers or businesses formed to control prices, supply, or competition in a market.
senses.ms_definition: Persatuan antarabangsa pengeluar atau pengusaha sesuatu barangan untuk menguasai pasaran, termasuk mengawal harga.
senses.nuances: DBP 释义突出国际性生产者联合；当代经济语境也用于国内企业之间的市场串通。不能把任何行业协会或价格相近现象直接称作 kartel。释义依据：[DBP：kartel](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kartel)。

tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。

kau 适用于熟人之间，正式交流宜改用姓名、职称或合适的称呼。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论尚待调查的情况，可说 disyaki terlibat dalam kegiatan kartel（涉嫌参与卡特尔活动）；避免把传闻直接表述为已证实事实。

etymology.historical_story: Kartel belongs to a European family of words associated with written agreements. French cartel goes back to Italian cartello, originally a notice or written document. The commercial meaning later developed around agreements between businesses. This explains the connection between a simple written arrangement and coordinated control of a market. The precise route into Malay is not established here. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9C0931).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kartel ≈“卡特尔”：记住几家企业围桌商量价格的画面；核心是联合控制市场。

senses.zh_definition: 悬浮在近地面空气中、使景物不清晰的细小水滴；雾。
senses.en_definition: Tiny airborne water droplets near the ground that obscure visibility; fog or mist.
senses.ms_definition: Wap air yang kelihatan seperti asap yang berada dekat muka bumi, biasanya pada waktu pagi.
senses.nuances: 词典以 wap air 作传统描述，科学上可见雾主要由液态小水滴组成。烟霾通常称 jerebu，烟称 asap。

senses.zh_definition: 液体经喷洒、喷射等形成并悬浮于空气中的细小液滴；喷雾。
senses.en_definition: A mist of fine liquid droplets produced by spraying or jetting.
senses.ms_definition: Cecair halus-halus yang terjadi daripada semburan, pancutan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 此义见 Kamus Pelajar；不局限于自然形成的水雾，液体种类由上下文确定。

senses.zh_definition: 模糊不清的；仿佛被雾遮住而看不清楚的。
senses.en_definition: Indistinct, dim, or blurred, as though obscured by mist.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak nyata kelihatan, tidak terang; kabur, kelam.
senses.nuances: DBP 收有此形容词义；现代一般表达更常用 kabur。以下为说明该义的搭配，不宜标为高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Malay turns clearing weather into an image of relief in the proverb hilang kabus teduh hujan: comfort follows hardship. The same word also describes an indistinct image and, in technical use, a spray of fine droplets. These meanings connect obscured sight with suspended liquid, offering a cultural memory route rather than a speculative account of the word's origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kabus 与 kabur（模糊）并排记：kabus 一来，景物就 kabur。这是词义联想，不是构词关系。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；kai 中 ai 构成双元音 /aj/，不拆成 ka.i。

etymology.historical_story: Kaisar belongs to the international family of imperial titles associated with Latin Caesar. A Roman family name became a title of rule and travelled across languages; Arabic qaysar is one related form. Malay writes kaisar as قيصر in Jawi. The resemblance connects the word to imperial history, without establishing a single direct borrowing route into Malay. [TDV: Kayser](https://islamansiklopedisi.org.tr/kayser)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaisar 与 Caesar（凯撒）联想在一起：从“凯撒”想到“皇帝”；这是词源联系，不是马来语词缀拆分。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Kuwait → Kuwait（马来语中作为完整国名使用）
morphology.pattern_note: 不按马来语词缀拆分。规范书写为 Kuwait；所列 IPA 为马来语宽式读音参考。阿拉伯语中的历史构词不等于现代马来语构词。

senses.zh_definition: 科威特，位于阿拉伯半岛东北部、海湾沿岸的国家，邻接伊拉克和沙特阿拉伯。
senses.en_definition: Kuwait, a country on the Gulf coast of the northeastern Arabian Peninsula, bordering Iraq and Saudi Arabia.
senses.ms_definition: Negara di bahagian timur laut Semenanjung Arab, di pesisir Teluk Parsi, yang bersempadan dengan Iraq dan Arab Saudi.
senses.nuances: 属国名专有名词，规范拼写为 Kuwait。status 的 official 表示正式国名用法，不表示输入包提供了 DBP 词条；本条马来语定义为编辑释义。国家与首都应按语境区分，首都可明确写作 Bandar Kuwait。马来西亚官方用例：[马来西亚驻科威特大使馆](https://www.kln.gov.my/web/kwt_kuwait/home)。
