etymology.historical_story: Kuwait comes from an Arabic diminutive associated with kout, a fortified building beside water. The name therefore carries the image of a small fort, linking the modern country to an older coastal settlement. Malay adopts the geographical name as a whole rather than reproducing its Arabic word-formation pattern. Source: [Embassy of Kuwait](https://www.kuwait-embassy.or.jp/E_outline_04.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ku-wait，联想海湾岸边的“小堡垒”；这是国名的历史线索，不是马来语拆词公式。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身无词缀。派生为 mengutui 时，meN- 在 /k/ 前实现为 meng-，词根起首 k 脱落：meN- + kutu + -i → mengutui。

word_family.gloss: 生虱；在另一同形词词族中指结伙

senses.zh_definition: 虱子；泛指某些附着于人发、动物毛皮或植物上的细小虫类，具体种类由搭配确定。
senses.en_definition: A louse, or another small pest designated by a qualifying expression.
senses.ms_definition: Binatang kecil yang terdapat pada rambut manusia, bulu haiwan atau tempat lain; jenisnya dikenal pasti melalui nama khusus.
senses.nuances: 对应 DBP 的 kutu I。不能把所有 kutu 类名称都按生物分类译为虱子。kutu air 是病名表达；kutu embun、kutu jalan 和 kutu rayau 指游荡者；mati kutu 表示束手无策或窘得无话可说，均须整体理解。

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates kutu into two homonymous entries: one concerns tiny pests, and the other includes commercial association and rotating savings. The savings meaning reflects cooperation through regular contributions and turns at receiving a shared pool. This dictionary distinction matters: a memorable story connecting insects with saving money would not establish a historical relationship between the words.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan separates kecoh into two homonymous entries: deception and noisy commotion. That distinction offers a useful cultural reading lesson: a bustling scene and a dishonest transaction need different interpretations, despite identical spelling. The supplied evidence does not establish the word’s ultimate origin or prove that one meaning historically developed from the other.

etymology.historical_story: Komik closely resembles English comic, although the evidence consulted does not establish its precise borrowing route. In Malaysia, the medium also supports language and script learning: DBP has organized Jawi comic competitions with local creators. That practice illustrates how illustrated storytelling can carry cultural education as well as entertainment, beyond the humorous emphasis of an older dictionary definition. [Source: DBP](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2023/09/26/9858/).

etymology.historical_story: Kelinci carries a trace of European contact in the archipelago. The World Loanword Database identifies Indonesian kelinci as a borrowing from Dutch konijntje, meaning little rabbit, associated with Dutch colonial contact. Malay also records kelinci, while Malaysian speakers generally favour arnab. The two familiar names illustrate how neighbouring language communities can share an animal term yet develop different everyday preferences. [World Loanword Database](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839112214375)

etymology.historical_story: Krrish entered popular culture as the title of a Hindi superhero film released in 2006. The distributor's synopsis introduces Krishna, a young man who inherits extraordinary powers and assumes the identity Krrish while confronting a dangerous scientist in Singapore. This establishes the name's cinematic context. It does not establish a Malay lexical root, an official Jawi spelling, or a general meaning such as hero. [Yash Raj Films](https://www.yashrajfilms.com/movies/krrish)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把短促的 /krɪʃ/ 连到电影里的蒙面英雄画面：Krrish 是角色名和片名，像人名一样整词记住，不拆成马来语词根。

etymology.historical_story: Kerah carries a historical association with compulsory service owed to a ruler or government, including unpaid public work. Modern usage retains the idea of gathering people under direction, but extends it to rescue teams, volunteers and personal effort. Kerahkan adds -kan to this base. Historical context: [Kamus Dewan, DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kerah).

etymology.historical_story: Malay kompleks is identified by DBP as an English borrowing. English complex has Latin ancestry associated with embracing or comprising connected elements. That image helps connect a difficult system with a collection of buildings: both contain related parts. The psychological and chemical senses are specialized extensions. etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this expression through two productive grammatical steps. Hidup supplies the idea of living; ke-...-an forms kehidupan, referring to life or the circumstances of living. The attached pronoun -nya then connects that life to someone or something already mentioned. This layered structure lets one familiar root describe both personal experience and material circumstances.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 hidup「活着」：kehidupan 是「生活」，再接 -nya「他／她／它的」，就是「其生活」。

etymology.historical_story: Katherine descends from Greek Aikaterine, whose ultimate origin remains disputed. Early Christian tradition associated the name with Greek katharos, meaning pure, influencing its later spelling. The name spread through traditions surrounding Saint Catherine of Alexandria. That historical association explains a familiar interpretation, but does not establish purity as the original meaning. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/katherine).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“凯瑟琳”联结 Katherine 的英语读音；先记开头重读 /kæθ/，再记整个人名，不把词尾 ine 当成马来语后缀。

etymology.historical_story: The international word family behind kardinal ultimately connects with Latin cardo, meaning hinge, and cardinalis, meaning principal or pivotal. etymology.historical_story: Fikir is an Arabic loan associated with fikr, meaning thought or reflection. Malay combines this borrowed base with ku-, its shortened first-person pronoun, to create a distinctly personal expression. The resulting form illustrates how borrowed vocabulary becomes part of Malay grammar: the intellectual vocabulary travels, while the speaker’s voice is supplied locally. [Historical dictionary](https://ms.wikisource.org/wiki/Malay-English_Vocabulary/F)

etymology.historical_story: Kuberitahu brings together ku-, the shortened form of aku, and beritahu, whose familiar components evoke giving someone knowledge. Its compact appearance illustrates Malay's convention of attaching shortened personal pronouns to neighbouring words. This helps explain why the form feels especially at home in intimate writing and literary narration, although ordinary conversation often uses the fuller aku beritahu. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Kuasa has a history linked to Sanskrit vaśa, meaning power or control, through Old Javanese forms. The modern suffix -i produces kuasai. Its meanings connect authority over territory, control of oneself, and mastery of knowledge: a learner can therefore encounter the same word in accounts of political power and advice about learning languages. [Scholarly source](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Khanna occurs in personal names such as Rajesh Khanna, whose name is documented in an Indian government release. Personal names can enter Malay texts through reporting and discussion without becoming Malay common words. The supplied lowercase token lacks enough context to establish that identity, so no surname origin or Malay lexical history is assigned here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认身份，再记含义：看到 khanna，先查原句是否为姓氏 Khanna；不要编造普通词义或词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入；kh 通常表示 /x/，不应拆成马来语词缀。派生形式 mengkhuatiri、mengkhuatirkan 保留 kh。

senses.zh_definition: 因想到可能发生的不利情况而感到担心、忧虑或心神不安。
senses.en_definition: To feel worried or apprehensive about something that may happen.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa bimbang atau gelisah kerana memikirkan kemungkinan berlakunya sesuatu yang tidak diingini.
senses.nuances: 表示忧虑心理，未必达到惊恐程度。DBP 词库将其列为 kata kerja；中文和英文常用形容词表达相同状态。可接 akan、tentang 或以 kalau-kalau 引出担忧内容。这里的马来语释义依据词典改写。[DBP：khuatir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=khuatir+)

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 社区安全汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penduduk khuatir akan keselamatan anak-anak mereka berikutan peningkatan jumlah kenderaan berat di kawasan perumahan itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 由于该住宅区的重型车辆增多，居民担心孩子们的安全。
dual_scenarios.en: Residents are concerned about their children's safety following an increase in heavy vehicles in the residential area.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友报平安
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan khuatir lah, aku dah sampai kat rumah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan khuatir, saya sudah sampai di rumah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 别担心啦，我已经到家了。
dual_scenarios.en: Don't worry, I'm home already.
spoken_features: lah 在此缓和安慰语气。
dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 在此对应标准语 di。
aku 适合熟悉的朋友之间使用。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku khuatir lah, kau tak balas mesej dari tadi. Dah sampai ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya khuatir kerana awak tidak membalas mesej sejak tadi. Adakah awak sudah sampai?
messages.zh: 我都担心了，你刚才一直没回消息。到了吗？
messages.en: I was getting worried—you hadn't replied for a while. Have you arrived?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)

messages.zh: 到了，我已经在家了。刚才手机没电了，别担心。
messages.en: Yes, I'm home now. My phone ran out of battery earlier. Don't worry.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Saya khuatir… 可委婉引出顾虑，适合向同事或上级表达担心；说明具体原因会比直接否定更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Jangan khuatir 适合安慰，但对方确有困难时，最好补充行动或信息，例如说明已经安全到家。朋友间也常用 risau 表达担心。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Saya khuatir… 可委婉引出顾虑，适合向同事或上级表达担心；说明具体原因会比直接否定更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: Jangan khuatir 适合安慰，但对方确有困难时，最好补充行动或信息，例如说明已经安全到家。朋友间也常用 risau 表达担心。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies khuatir as an Arabic loanword. Its spelling preserves kh, a useful reminder of that connection. In Malay, the borrowed word belongs to the intimate language of concern: waiting for someone to return, fearing an accident, or anticipating trouble. Its derivatives distinguish feeling concern from causing it. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=khuatir+)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 khuatir 联想成心里一直“挂着”的事：人还没回来，心就放不下。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 jatuh；ke-...-an 不改变词根拼写，可表示下落事件、衰败状态或遭受坠物的经历。

senses.zh_definition: 下落、坠落的事件或过程。
senses.en_definition: The occurrence or process of falling.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal jatuh; jatuhnya sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 侧重下落事件；描述某个人意外跌倒时，通常直接使用 jatuh 或 terjatuh。此义及后续基本义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=kejatuhan)。

senses.zh_definition: 政权、势力等的垮台或覆灭；价格、价值或地位等的下降。
senses.en_definition: The downfall or collapse of a power or institution, or a decline in value, price, or standing.
senses.ms_definition: Keruntuhan kuasa atau kemerosotan nilai, harga dan kedudukan.
senses.nuances: 新闻、历史和经济报道中的常见用法。kejatuhan kerajaan 通常表示政府垮台；kejatuhan harga 可以只是价格下降，并不必然表示市场崩溃。

senses.zh_definition: 被落下的东西击中或砸到。
senses.en_definition: To be struck by something falling.
senses.ms_definition: Terkena atau tertimpa sesuatu yang jatuh.
senses.nuances: 主语是遭受坠物的人或物，后面接落下的东西。与名词性 kejatuhan objek 的句法不同。马来西亚日常表达也常用 ditimpa 或 kena。

collocations.en: to be hit by a falling coconut
to be struck by a falling tree branch

senses.zh_definition: 在固定表达 kejatuhan bulan 中，指得到幸福或意外的好处。
senses.en_definition: In the idiom kejatuhan bulan, to receive happiness or unexpected good fortune.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapat kebahagiaan atau kesenangan.
senses.nuances: 属于传统比喻义，依赖 bulan 构成固定表达；不能把 kejatuhan 单独理解为走运。下列为习语用例，现代口语中不如普通的 untung 或 bertuah 常见。

collocations.en: as though blessed with unexpected good fortune

pasal 在此相当于 tentang

messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca berita tentang kejatuhan harga getah itu. Adakah pendapatan ayah kamu terjejas?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于历史、经济和新闻分析时语体正式；谈及某个人的 kejatuhan，可能带有批判或幸灾乐祸的意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 描述他人失势或财务损失时宜保持客观。报告坠物事故时应明确受害者与坠落物，避免名词义和遭受义混淆。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于历史、经济和新闻分析时语体正式；谈及某个人的 kejatuhan，可能带有批判或幸灾乐祸的意味。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 描述他人失势或财务损失时宜保持客观。报告坠物事故时应明确受害者与坠落物，避免名词义和遭受义混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Built from jatuh, meaning to fall, kejatuhan connects physical descent with political defeat and economic decline. Malaysian historical writing offers a memorable example: kejatuhan Melaka names the fall of Melaka to the Portuguese in 1511. The expression illustrates how the same word can describe both downward movement and the loss of power. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=kejatuhan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ja-tuh＝掉下；ke-...-an 把它框成事件或状态：价格掉下是下跌，政权掉下是垮台。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆。kh 表示一个清软腭擦音 /x/，y 表示 /j/；不能拆成 k + hayal。派生词 mengkhayalkan 保留 kh。

senses.zh_definition: 幻想；心中想象出来而未必实际存在的形象、情景或事物。
senses.en_definition: An imagined image, situation, or creation; fantasy.
senses.ms_definition: Gambaran atau rekaan yang timbul dalam fikiran dan tidak semestinya wujud dalam kenyataan; angan-angan atau fantasi.
senses.nuances: 此义相当于 khayalan，常用于文学及现实与幻想的对照。并非一切创造性想象都带贬义；日常指“做白日梦”通常用 berkhayal。

senses.zh_definition: 入迷的；沉醉或出神的，因过度专注于某事而忽略周围。
senses.en_definition: Absorbed, entranced, or lost in thought to the point of becoming inattentive.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat asyik atau leka ketika melakukan, mendengar atau memikirkan sesuatu sehingga kurang menyedari keadaan sekeliling.
senses.nuances: 可以形容被音乐吸引、陷入回忆或沉浸于活动，不必涉及酒精或毒品。若只想中性地称赞专注，tekun 或 fokus 往往更准确。

senses.zh_definition: 因毒品或其他致醉物质影响而神志恍惚、飘飘然的。
senses.en_definition: High or mentally intoxicated under the influence of drugs or another intoxicating substance.
senses.ms_definition: Berada dalam keadaan fikiran atau kesedaran yang terganggu akibat pengaruh dadah atau bahan yang mengkhayalkan.
senses.nuances: DBP 的语言咨询明确用 khayal 对应吸毒语境中的 high。不能据此将所有 khayal 都解释为吸毒，也不宜把它当作普通酒醉 mabuk 的无条件替换词。

collocations.zh: 因毒品作用而神志恍惚

dual_scenarios.ms: Novel itu membawa pembaca ke alam khayal melalui gambaran sebuah kota yang tidak pernah wujud.

dual_scenarios.en: The novel takes readers into a world of fantasy through its portrayal of a city that never existed.

etymology.historical_story: Khayal is borrowed from Arabic khayāl, associated with imagination or a mental image. Malay uses the word for both imagined worlds and the state of becoming absorbed in an experience. This connection offers a useful semantic bridge: attention moves away from immediate surroundings, whether through fantasy, music, or, in another established usage, intoxicating substances.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kha-yal 想成两步：先走进幻想，再忘了周围。khayal 的共同画面就是心神离开眼前。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为词根记忆。派生时，meN- 或 peN- 在 k 前采用 meng- 或 peng-，词首 k 脱落：mengendalikan、pengendali。

senses.zh_definition: 控制马匹用的衔具或马嚼子。
senses.en_definition: A bit or restraining fitting used to control a horse.
senses.ms_definition: Kekang yang dipasang pada mulut kuda untuk mengawalnya.
senses.nuances: DBP标注 Jw，表示爪哇语来源。此处是具体的马具义；派生动词 mengendalikan 另有控制、操作和管理等义。[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kendali)

senses.zh_definition: 骑手用来引导、约束马匹的缰绳。
senses.en_definition: Reins used to guide or restrain a horse.
senses.ms_definition: Tali kekang yang dipegang untuk mengarahkan atau menahan kuda.
senses.nuances: 强调骑手手中牵引马匹的绳带；tali kekang 是更直接易懂的近义表达。马来西亚正式行文中，表示操作或管理通常使用 mengendalikan，表示抽象控制通常使用 kawalan。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels kendali as Javanese in origin and records its concrete meanings as a horse's bit and reins. Its Malay derivatives extend into restraint, supervision, and administration. As a learning image, the rider guiding a horse provides a bridge to someone guiding a team, operating equipment, or managing an organization. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kendali)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ken-da-li 的三拍想成握缰、引导、稳住：先记马具，再连接 mengendalikan 的控制和管理义。

senses.zh_definition: 大学为某个学术领域设置的教授席位，常具有专门研究方向或冠名。

etymology.historical_story: Kursi and kerusi belong to the Malay vocabulary borrowed from Arabic kursiyy, meaning a chair or seat; this connection is discussed in [research on Malay loanwords](https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/EJ1474738.pdf). Malaysian usage gives kursi a specialized academic meaning: a professorial chair. Remembering the shared image of a seat helps connect the physical object with an established position of learning and authority.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kursi 和 kerusi 联想记：kerusi 是坐人的椅子，学术语境的 kursi 是教授的“席位”。

morphology.formula: kesalahan + -nya → kesalahannya；底层名词：ke- + salah + -an → kesalahan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的直接基底 kesalahan；底层词根为 salah。-nya 是附着代词或定指成分，ny 表示 /ɲ/，不触发词首音变。数据包 Jawi کسالهن 实际仅对应 kesalahan；完整词形应附加 ڽ，写作 کسالهنڽ。分音按完整词形补全。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或它的错误、失误；或上下文中已经明确的那项错误。
senses.en_definition: His, her or its mistake or error; the contextually identified error.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau perkara yang salah, termasuk kesilapan, yang dikaitkan dengan orang atau perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 不区分性别，也不自动表示复数。可指某人的错误，也可回指某份文件等事物中的错误。这里是将 DBP 的 kesalahan 释义应用于带 -nya 的词形，并非独立的官方引文。参见 [DBP：kesalahan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kesalahan)。

senses.zh_definition: 某人的过错、违规行为或违法行为；具体性质由语境确定。
senses.en_definition: A person's wrongdoing, breach of rules or offence, as determined by context.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan salah yang melanggar peraturan atau undang-undang dan dilakukan oleh pihak yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: kesalahan 的范围比 jenayah（犯罪）广，可用于轻微违规、纪律问题或法律上的违法行为。仅凭 kesalahannya 不能判断行为是否构成犯罪。该义基于 [DBP 对 kesalahan 的释义说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kesilapan)。

collocations.zh: 因其违规或违法行为受到处罚

senses.zh_definition: 某人对不良结果所负的过错或责任。
senses.en_definition: The fault or blame attributable to a person for an undesirable outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Hal salah atau tanggungjawab atas sesuatu kejadian buruk yang dikaitkan dengan orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 常见于 Itu kesalahannya（那是他／她的错）和 Bukan kesalahannya（不是他／她的错）。重点在责任归属，不一定指一项可具体指出的操作错误。

lah 在劝说中缓和命令语气。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Itu kesalahannya 带有归责意味。在职场中谈小失误，用 kesilapan 或具体描述问题通常较委婉；谈纪律违规时则应明确行为和依据。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合认错、纠错及讨论责任。向当事人直接认错应说 kesalahan saya（我的错误），不能把 kesalahannya 当作第一人称形式。-nya 的指代须由上下文明确，避免让听者误判被责备的人。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 Itu kesalahannya 带有归责意味。在职场中谈小失误，用 kesilapan 或具体描述问题通常较委婉；谈纪律违规时则应明确行为和依据。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合认错、纠错及讨论责任。向当事人直接认错应说 kesalahan saya（我的错误），不能把 kesalahannya 当作第一人称形式。-nya 的指代须由上下文明确，避免让听者误判被责备的人。

etymology.historical_story: Kesalahannya shows how Malay builds a whole relationship into one written word. Salah expresses being wrong; ke-...-an forms the noun kesalahan, an error or wrongdoing. Attached -nya then connects that noun to someone or something already understood. Because -nya carries no gender distinction, context supplies the English choice between his, her, its or a definite expression.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步串起来：salah＝错；kesalahan＝错误这件事；加 -nya＝他／她／它的错误，或前文说的那个错误。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成 kom- 与 -pas；下列词族项为复合词。

senses.zh_definition: 用于辨别方位的罗盘，通常利用可自由转动的磁针指示北方。
senses.en_definition: An instrument for finding directions, typically using a freely moving magnetic needle that points north.
senses.ms_definition: Alat penentu arah mata angin yang mempunyai jarum magnetik yang bergerak bebas dan menunjuk ke arah utara.
senses.nuances: 一般语境中首先理解为辨别方向的罗盘。磁针指向磁北，精确导航时须考虑磁偏角。两项基本词义依据：[DBP：kompas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kompas)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于画圆或量取地图、图表上距离的双脚工具；圆规。
senses.en_definition: A two-legged instrument used to draw circles or measure distances on maps and charts.
senses.ms_definition: Alat berkaki dua untuk melukis bulatan atau mengukur jarak pada peta dan carta; jangka lukis.
senses.nuances: 在数学或制图语境中可指圆规；为避免与导航罗盘混淆，表达画圆工具时可用更明确的 jangka lukis。

etymology.historical_story: Kompas brings navigation and geometry together in one Malay word. Kamus Dewan records both the instrument that indicates direction and the two-legged tool used for circles or map measurements. This shared vocabulary offers a useful cultural connection between finding a route across a landscape and constructing one on paper. The cited entry does not establish the borrowing route. [DBP: kompas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kompas).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kompas 与英语 compass 形近：想象一根指针找北、两条规脚画圆，记住两个义项。

morphology.pattern_note: 规范形式是分写的 ke hadapan；ke 是独立介词，不是前缀。-an 属于 hadapan 的构词。音标对应规范短语。

senses.zh_definition: 向前；往前面。规范写法为 ke hadapan，合写形式 kehadapan 不规范。
senses.en_definition: Forward; towards the front. The standard Malay spelling is ke hadapan, written as two words.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ejaan tidak baku bagi frasa ke hadapan, yang bermaksud ke depan atau ke muka.
senses.nuances: 词性标签表示整段短语的方向状语功能；内部结构为介词 ke 加方位词 hadapan。规范搭配和例句均采用分写形式。拼写依据：[DBP：ke hadapan 的分写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menunjukkan+1)。

senses.zh_definition: 向前发展；朝更进步的阶段迈进。规范写法为 ke hadapan。
senses.en_definition: Forward in development or progress.
senses.ms_definition: Ke arah kemajuan atau perkembangan, sebagai penggunaan kiasan frasa ke hadapan.
senses.nuances: 这是空间方向义的比喻用法，不等于所有语境中的“未来”；表示未来时间通常用 pada masa hadapan。

senses.zh_definition: 致；用于传统书信开头，引出收信人。规范写法为 ke hadapan。
senses.en_definition: To; used before the addressee in a traditional letter opening.
senses.ms_definition: Pada permulaan surat, frasa ke hadapan membawa maksud kepada.
senses.nuances: 属于传统书信用语，常与 ayahanda、bonda、sahabat 等称呼连用。现代公务信件通常直接列明收信人的姓名或职衔。词义依据：[DBP：hadapan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=hadapan)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请人向前移动时，Boleh bergerak sedikit ke hadapan? 比直接命令 Maju! 更客气；工作人员也可用 Sila bergerak ke hadapan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 作文、公文和正式消息中写 ke hadapan。传统书信中的 Ke hadapan ayahanda 带庄重、亲敬色彩，日常聊天通常无需使用。

etymology.historical_story: The standard expression ke hadapan combines the directional preposition ke with hadapan, meaning the front. Its letter-writing use preserves another perspective: words are respectfully directed before an addressee. Kamus Dewan records this opening formula alongside physical direction. The joined spelling kehadapan obscures the grammatical boundary, so DBP guidance requires two separate words. [DBP: hadapan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=hadapan), [DBP: spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hadir).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ke 表示“往”，hadapan 表示“前面”：往前走，两个词也要留出一步空格——ke hadapan。

morphology.pattern_note: 整体借入的词根。保留输入的音节标记 qu.dus；普通马来语读音通常以 /k/ 起首。派生 menguduskan 时，meN- 在词根首音 /k/ 前实现为 meng-，原来的 k 脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 神圣的；圣洁的，具有宗教意义上的纯洁性。
senses.en_definition: Holy or sacred; spiritually pure.
senses.ms_definition: Suci; bersih; tidak bercela.
senses.nuances: 带有明显的宗教或庄重色彩。基督宗教用语 Roh Kudus 指圣灵；伊斯兰用语 roh al-Kudus 可指吉卜力天使，两者须按各自信仰语境理解。[DBP：kudus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kudus)

senses.en_definition: Morally pure or untainted, especially in heart or intention.
senses.ms_definition: Murni dan tidak bercela dari segi hati atau batin.
senses.nuances: 常见于文学、宗教劝诫或抒情表达。比一般的 baik 或 ikhlas 更庄重；通常不用来描述刚洗干净的衣物或餐具。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies kudus as an Arabic loanword. In Malay, it belongs to the vocabulary of holiness and inward purity, rather than ordinary washing or tidiness. Its cultural reach crosses religious settings: Christian Roh Kudus and Islamic roh al-Kudus share vocabulary, while their referents must be understood within their respective traditions. [DBP: kudus](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kudus)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ku-dus 时，想象心上的污点逐一消失：kudus 是心灵上的“圣洁、无瑕”。这是意象记忆，不是词源解释。

senses.nuances: 与单纯表示“发笑”的 ketawa 不同，此形式指向发笑对象。Jangan ketawakan dia 可表示“别取笑他”。正式主动句通常用 mengetawakan 或 mentertawakan；不能把所有主动句里的 meN- 任意省略。义项依据 [DBP PRPM：mengetawakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=mengetawakan) 编写，马来语释义为转述。

etymology.historical_story: DBP connects ketawa with tawa and records mengetawakan as a related verb. Ketawakan is transparent through its immediate base ketawa and the suffix -kan. This word family links the act of laughing with its target or cause. That relationship supports a morphological explanation without requiring an invented historical origin. etymology.historical_story: Komunis belongs to an international family of political terms that includes English communist and Malay komunisme. Malay treats it as a complete borrowed base rather than a native affixed formation. DBP records both the adherent meaning and combinations such as parti komunis and blok komunis. These uses distinguish people, organisations and political alignments through the surrounding nouns.

etymology.historical_story: The name ultimately belongs to the Greek and Latin history of Christianity. Its older sense concerns universality or the whole, which helps explain why the Church describes itself as catholic. Malay uses Katolik as a religious name, so learners should distinguish this historical meaning from its present reference to the Catholic Church. [Vatican explanation](https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/en/audiences/2014/documents/papa-francesco_20140917_udienza-generale.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: 这里的 ke 是独立书写的介词，不是前缀；kerumah 应改为 ke rumah。输入包把 kerumah 标为词根，需纠正。音标对应规范短语；原包未提供音节和爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 规范短语 ke rumah：表示移动的目的地为某处住宅，即到家里、到某人的住处。
senses.en_definition: Nonstandard joined spelling of ke rumah: to a house or someone's home.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi frasa ke rumah, yang menunjukkan rumah sebagai tempat yang dituju.
senses.nuances: 词类标签对应短语中心词 ke；整个 ke rumah 是介词短语。它表示目的地，di rumah 表示所在位置；是否译为“回家”取决于语境。规范拼写及方向用法参见 [DBP：kata sendi ke](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kadang)。以下搭配和例句采用规范拼写。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here concerns spelling rather than a separate word origin. Malay writes the directional preposition ke separately from its destination, giving ke rumah. Joining the words obscures that grammatical boundary. The same pattern appears in ke sekolah and ke pejabat, making this correction a reusable guide to everyday Malay destinations.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于材料工程术语，本身不带敬语或贬义。向非专业人士介绍时，可先说明它是一种用于玻璃封接的特殊合金。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 商业或技术文件中通常写作 Kovar，品牌资料也可能写作 Kovar®。不要把所有低膨胀合金都称为 kovar；本条不虚构马来语派生词或官方爪夷文。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于材料工程术语，本身不带敬语或贬义。向非专业人士介绍时，可先说明它是一种用于玻璃封接的特殊合金。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 商业或技术文件中通常写作 Kovar，品牌资料也可能写作 Kovar®。不要把所有低膨胀合金都称为 kovar；本条不虚构马来语派生词或官方爪夷文。

etymology.historical_story: Kovar entered technical vocabulary as a commercial alloy name. Its cultural setting is the electronics workshop: glass and metal must remain joined while temperatures change. Controlling the alloy's expansion helps protect that seal. The manufacturer's documentation identifies the material as an iron–nickel–cobalt alloy; it does not establish an etymological expansion of the name. [Manufacturer documentation](https://carpentertechnology.com/hubfs/7407324/Material%20Saftey%20Data%20Sheets/Kovar.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kovar 联想中文材料名“可伐”：记住“可伐配玻璃，受热也要合拍”。这是用途联想，不是名称的真实词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 附着后不改变基形拼写，ny 表示 /ɲ/；它可回指前文，也可起强调作用，不一定表示领属。所给爪夷文是 keseluruhan 的拼写，未包含 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 前述事物的全部内容、全部范围或完整整体。
senses.en_definition: The entirety of something previously mentioned; the complete whole.
senses.ms_definition: Seluruh bahagian atau isi sesuatu yang telah disebut, dilihat sebagai satu kesatuan yang lengkap.
senses.nuances: 作为名词使用时，-nya 通常回指已提及的文章、事件或事物。整体不仅指数量相加，也可指各部分构成的完整意义。此释义依据基形 keseluruhan 的词义整理。[DBP：keseluruhan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=keseluruhan)

senses.zh_definition: 全部地；完全地；表示所述情况涵盖全部对象或范围。
senses.en_definition: Entirely or wholly, covering the full amount or extent.
senses.ms_definition: Dengan meliputi semua bahagian atau jumlah sesuatu, tanpa meninggalkan sebahagiannya.
senses.nuances: 表示覆盖范围完整。例如费用 keseluruhannya ditanggung 表示费用全部获承担。与表示概括评价的 secara keseluruhannya 有别；hampir keseluruhannya 则表示几乎全部。

senses.zh_definition: 总体而言；从整体情况来看。
senses.en_definition: Overall; when considered as a whole.
senses.ms_definition: Secara umum setelah semua aspek sesuatu perkara dipertimbangkan.
senses.nuances: 此功能通常由整个短语 secara keseluruhannya 或 pada keseluruhannya 承担，适合总结报告与整体评价。它允许个别例外，不表示每一个细节都相同。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=keseluruhan)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：总结项目表现
dual_scenarios.ms: Secara keseluruhannya, projek ini telah mencapai objektif yang ditetapkan walaupun beberapa kerja pembaikan masih diperlukan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 总体而言，这个项目已达到既定目标，但仍有一些地方需要改进。
dual_scenarios.en: Overall, the project has met its objectives, although some improvements are still needed.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp：朋友讨论住宿体验
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Secara keseluruhannya, hotel tu okey je, cuma bilik dia kecil sikit.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Secara keseluruhannya, hotel itu memuaskan, cuma biliknya agak kecil.
dual_scenarios.zh: 整体来说，那家酒店还行，就是房间小了点。
dual_scenarios.en: Overall, the hotel was fine; the room was just a bit small.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
okey je 表示还可以、没什么大问题，je 对应 sahaja。
bilik dia 在口语中可指酒店的房间；标准表达用 biliknya。
sikit 对应 sedikit，此处用于缓和批评。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Secara keseluruhannya, hotel tu okey tak? Aku nak tempah untuk hujung minggu ni.
messages.ms_standard: Secara keseluruhannya, adakah hotel itu memuaskan? Saya mahu membuat tempahan untuk hujung minggu ini.
messages.zh: 那家酒店整体还行吗？我想订这个周末的。
messages.en: Was the hotel good overall? I'm thinking of booking it for this weekend.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey je. Bilik dia kecil sikit, tapi senang nak cari makan kat situ.
messages.ms_standard: Hotel itu memuaskan. Biliknya agak kecil, tetapi mudah untuk mendapatkan makanan di situ.
messages.zh: 还行啦。房间小了点，不过附近找吃的很方便。
messages.en: It was fine. The room was a little small, but there were plenty of places to eat nearby.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 常用于报告、会议和评价，语气中性。先给出总体评价，再说明具体不足，可使反馈更清楚、较易接受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合总结已经讨论过的内容。涉及金额、责任或完成比例时，应区分总体不错与全部完成，避免把概括评价误当成无例外的保证。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 常用于报告、会议和评价，语气中性。先给出总体评价，再说明具体不足，可使反馈更清楚、较易接受。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合总结已经讨论过的内容。涉及金额、责任或完成比例时，应区分总体不错与全部完成，避免把概括评价误当成无例外的保证。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this expression around seluruh, meaning whole or entire. The ke-…-an construction produces keseluruhan, a noun for totality or wholeness. Adding -nya can connect that whole to something already mentioned. In the established phrase pada keseluruhannya, attention shifts from individual parts to a general assessment of the complete picture. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=keseluruhan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 seluruh＝整个：keseluruhan 是整体，keseluruhannya 是它的全部；前面加 secara，就记成把镜头拉远、看总体。

morphology.formula: ∅ + killer → killer（马来语使用层面整词记忆；英语内部为 kill + -er）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语来源的形式；-er 不是此处的马来语后缀。所列 IPA 为英语非卷舌读法，马来西亚使用者的实际读音可随语言背景变化。

word_family.gloss: 杀死；英语词，与 killer 同属英语词族
杀害；英语相关形式，不是马来语派生词

senses.zh_definition: 杀死人的人或动物；也指造成死亡的疾病、物质或其他因素。
senses.en_definition: A person, animal, disease, substance, or other agent that kills.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau haiwan yang membunuh, atau penyakit, bahan dan faktor lain yang menyebabkan kematian.
senses.nuances: 这是英语本义，在马来语语境中常作为英语词语出现。依对象可译为 pembunuh、penyakit yang membawa maut 等。杀死不必然等于谋杀，不能一律译成凶手。以下搭配保留英语形式。[Cambridge：killer](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/killer)

collocations.zh: 隐形杀手；无明显预警却可致命的因素

senses.zh_definition: 极难应付的；令人吃力或畏惧的，常形容考题、课程或任务。
senses.en_definition: Extremely difficult, demanding, or exhausting.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat sukar, mencabar atau meletihkan, khususnya apabila merujuk kepada soalan, subjek atau tugasan.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚校园口语中的英语借用，通常是夸张说法，不表示真正致命。正式报告宜按实际意思改为 sangat sukar 或 amat mencabar。大学材料中可见 killer subject 等用法。[UiTM 教学改进报告](https://perlis.uitm.edu.my/images/HEA/Pekeliling/3.Laporan%20Bersepadu%20CDL-CQI%20UiTM%20Cawangan%20Perlis%20Sesi%20Pengajian%20Mac%20-%20Ogos%202025.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 出色得令人印象深刻的；极有吸引力或效果极强的。
senses.en_definition: Exceptionally impressive, attractive, or effective.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat mengagumkan, menarik atau berkesan.
senses.nuances: 英语俚语中的褒义，可在英语与马来语混用时出现。须根据搭配判断褒贬：killer smile 是迷人笑容，killer question 则通常表示难题。以下是英语搭配，不是马来语标准固定短语。[Cambridge：killer](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/killer)

senses.zh_definition: 藤球队中的主攻手或扣杀手，主要负责以强力攻击争取得分。
senses.en_definition: The attacking player or spiker in a sepak takraw team.
senses.ms_definition: Pemain sepak takraw yang berperanan sebagai perejam untuk melakukan serangan dan mendapatkan mata.
senses.nuances: 这是马来西亚藤球报道中可见的角色名称，马来语对应词为 perejam。在此语境下不能按杀人者理解。大学官方报道直接使用 perejam (killer) 对应说明。[博特拉大学藤球报道](https://upm.edu.my/news/bekas_killer_takraw_negara_yang_lumpuh_terima_ijazah_bacelor-64845?L=bm)

dual_scenarios.context: 体育新闻：藤球队阵容安排
dual_scenarios.ms: Jurulatih memilih pemain paling berpengalaman sebagai killer utama pasukan sepak takraw negeri.
dual_scenarios.zh: 教练选派经验最丰富的球员担任州藤球队的主力扣杀手。
dual_scenarios.en: The coach selected the most experienced player as the state sepak takraw team's first-choice spiker.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp：同学讨论考试难题
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Soalan terakhir tu memang killer lah, aku tak sempat jawab habis.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Soalan terakhir itu memang sangat sukar, dan saya tidak sempat menjawabnya dengan lengkap.
dual_scenarios.zh: 最后那题真的难死了，我都来不及答完。
dual_scenarios.en: That last question was a real killer. I didn't have time to finish it.
spoken_features: killer 在此是英语借用，夸张地表示极难。
tu、tak 分别对应 itu、tidak。
lah 加强说话者的感受，不表示命令。
aku 用于熟悉的同辈之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Soalan terakhir tu memang killer lah. Kau sempat jawab habis tak?
messages.ms_standard: Soalan terakhir itu memang sangat sukar. Adakah kamu sempat menjawabnya dengan lengkap?
messages.zh: 最后那题真的难死了。你来得及答完吗？
messages.en: That last question was a real killer. Did you manage to finish it?

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak, aku jawab separuh je. Nanti kita bincang sama-sama, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Tidak, saya hanya sempat menjawab separuh daripadanya. Nanti kita bincangkannya bersama-sama.
messages.zh: 没，我只答了一半。等下我们一起讨论吧。
messages.en: No, I only got halfway through. Let's go over it together later.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 同学之间形容难题很自然；直接称老师或同事为 killer，可能被理解为严厉、可怕或带有敌意，应考虑关系和场合。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 须靠语境区分犯罪、夸张赞美、难度评价和藤球角色。正式一般写作宜使用明确的马来语对应词；体育报道中可在首次出现时写作 killer（perejam）。涉及真实伤亡或丧亲者时，避免把杀人意象当作玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: English forms killer from kill and the agent suffix -er. Its meanings extend from something that kills to something exceptionally demanding or impressive. In Malaysian usage, the borrowed form also appears in educational slang and sepak takraw. A takraw killer is a perejam: the attacker whose powerful strikes aim to finish a rally. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/killer), [Sport Singapore](https://www.activesgcircle.gov.sg/learn/sepak-takraw/game-procedure-and-player-positions-in-sepak-takraw)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一记终结比赛的扣杀：killer 可指杀人者，也可指藤球扣杀手；遇到 killer 难题，就是难得让人招架不住。

headword.verification_note: 可确认为波兰姓氏 Kowalski，但不能据此认定为正式马来语普通词。姓名应大写；输入排名仅保留为数据集排名。未提供或核实马来语标准读音、音节划分及爪夷文拼写。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为完整外来专名处理；is_root 仅表示本条不进行马来语词缀分析，不表示它是马来语本源词。波兰语的历史构词应与马来语形态分析区分。

senses.zh_definition: 科瓦尔斯基：波兰姓氏；在马来语文本中可作为人名使用，不具有已核实的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Kowalski, a Polish surname used as a proper name rather than an established Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Poland yang digunakan sebagai nama khas; huraian editorial ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 专名用法须写作 Kowalski。波兰语词源与 kowal（铁匠）有关，但不能把人名在句中直接译成“铁匠”。下列搭配是教学示例，未核实为高频搭配。姓氏背景参见 [Adam Mickiewicz Institute：波兰姓氏介绍](https://culture.pl/en/article/a-foreigners-guide-to-polish-surnames)。

etymology.historical_story: Kowalski belongs to Poland's surname tradition. The Adam Mickiewicz Institute explains its connection with kowal, meaning blacksmith, and the productive surname ending -ski. This history helps explain the name, but it does not give the surname a Malay dictionary meaning or establish the ancestry of any particular bearer. [Source](https://culture.pl/en/article/a-foreigners-guide-to-polish-surnames)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“姓氏名牌”：Kowalski 指称人；词源中的“铁匠”只帮助联想，不是姓名的逐字译法。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 构成表示用途、效益等的名词，词根 guna 不变；相邻两个 a 分属不同音节，实际发音可有 [ʔ] 分隔，如 [kəɡunaʔan]。纠正输入包的词根误判。

senses.zh_definition: 事物的用途、功能或能够带来的益处。
senses.en_definition: The use, purpose, function, or benefit of something.
senses.ms_definition: Tujuan sesuatu digunakan atau faedah yang dapat diperoleh daripadanya.
senses.nuances: 回答“有什么用、用来做什么”。kegunaan 偏重用途或效益；penggunaan 偏重使用行为、方式或用量。释义依据输入包所引 Kamus Dewan 义项改写；可参阅 [DBP：kegunaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=kegunaan)。

senses.zh_definition: 供某人、某群体或某项活动使用的需要或目的；在名词后也可表示用于某事的。
senses.en_definition: Use by a specified person or group, or for a specified purpose; also, being used for that purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Keperluan atau tujuan pemakaian oleh pihak tertentu; dalam binaan tertentu, sesuatu yang dipakai bagi tujuan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 常见于 untuk kegunaan sendiri 和 untuk kegunaan awam。输入包的“yang digunakan”体现于 alat kegunaan pertanian 等修饰结构；这是名词的关系性用法，不表示 kegunaan 已变成形容词。

etymology.historical_story: The root guna is traced to Sanskrit guṇa, associated with quality, merit, or an attribute. In Malay, guna centres on use and benefit. The circumfix ke-...-an builds kegunaan, a noun for usefulness or purpose. Its transparent modern structure connects an inherited loanword with productive Malay word formation, alongside berguna and menggunakan. [Etymological reference](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/guna).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 guna＝用；ke-...-an 把它变成“用途”。问 Apa kegunaannya?，就是问“它有什么用？”

etymology.historical_story: Kecerdasan makes an abstract noun from cerdas through the Malay circumfix ke-...-an. Its educational vocabulary centres on thinking and understanding. The same noun also serves technical language in kecerdasan buatan, showing how an established word for human mental ability can support terminology for computational systems without requiring a new everyday root.

etymology.historical_story: Kerang illustrates why a dictionary must preserve pronunciation as well as spelling. The familiar shellfish word has a schwa in its first syllable, while kérang in older expressions has a different vowel. Their shared spelling does not establish a shared origin. The available packet supplies no reliable account of the shellfish word's earliest history.

etymology.historical_story: Kakek illustrates how closely related languages can share a dictionary space without sharing everyday preferences. Kamus Dewan records it with the Indonesian label, while Malaysian speakers commonly choose datuk or atuk. The expression kakek moyang extends the family reference to ancestors. These documented uses explain its regional identity; they do not establish a deeper historical derivation. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kakek).

etymology.historical_story: Kecepatan illustrates Malay’s productive ke-...-an pattern: an adjective becomes a noun naming a quality or condition. Here cepat supplies the idea of quickness. The dictionary also records a Jakarta regional meaning, ‘too fast’. Those two meanings show why a word’s regional label matters alongside its spelling. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=cepat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cepat＝快；ke-...-an 把“快”装成一个名词：kecepatan＝速度。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代构词中整体作为词根，不把开头 ke- 单独拆出。派生 mengelilingi 时，meN- 在 k 前实现为 meng-，词根首音 k 脱落。

senses.nuances: 常见于 di keliling，整体表示“在……周围”；此结构中的 di 是介词，keliling 是方位名词。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=keliling)。

senses.zh_definition: 围成某个平面或区域的边界；该边界的总长度，即周长。
senses.en_definition: The boundary of an area, or its total length; perimeter.
senses.ms_definition: Batas yang menutup sesuatu bidang, atau jumlah panjang batas tersebut.
senses.nuances: 用于土地测量和几何；表示圆的周长时也常用 lilitan。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=keliling)。

senses.ms_definition: Bergerak mengitari sesuatu atau berjalan ke pelbagai tempat; bentuk percakapan bagi berkeliling.
senses.nuances: 朋友间可说 keliling bandar；正式行文按句法改用 berkeliling 或 mengelilingi。它不直接表示使人或物“被包围”。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=keliling)。

etymology.historical_story: Keliling connects space with circulation. Its dictionary family includes berkeliling for moving around and mengelilingi for surrounding or travelling around something. Pekeliling carries that circular idea into administration: a notice passes among its intended readers. This is a useful semantic connection, rather than a claim about the word’s earliest historical origin. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=keliling).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 ke-li-ling 时想象脚步绕一圈：地点的四周、图形的周长、人在四处逛，都围绕“绕一圈”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不发生音位替换；接上 -an 后，letih 的末尾 /h/ 成为最后一个音节的声母。ke-...-an 可表示疲倦的状态，也可表示处于极度疲倦的状态。

senses.zh_definition: 疲倦、疲劳的状态；身体或精神因活动、负担等而感到乏力。
senses.en_definition: The state of being tired or fatigued; weariness.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal letih; kepenatan.
senses.nuances: 名词义，常跟在 mengalami、mengatasi、akibat 或 kerana 后。既可指身体疲劳，也可指精神疲劳；本身不必然表示疾病或完全筋疲力尽。

senses.zh_definition: 十分疲倦的；因劳累而明显乏力的。
senses.en_definition: Very tired; exhausted.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat letih.
senses.nuances: 形容词义，常作谓语，如 Dia keletihan，也可出现在 kelihatan keletihan 等结构中。日常直接表达“累”通常使用 letih 或 penat；keletihan 的语气较重，也较适合叙述。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性，适用于报告、新闻和日常交流。向上司说明情况时，可说 Saya mengalami keletihan；熟人之间通常更简短地说 Saya penat。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于关心他人的身体或精神状态。对方表示 keletihan 时，宜理解为需要休息，不宜直接据此评价对方懒惰或缺乏能力。

etymology.historical_story: Keletihan illustrates Malay's productive habit of building vocabulary around a familiar root. Letih names tiredness directly; the surrounding ke-...-an construction presents it as a condition experienced by someone. The supplied Kamus Dewan entry preserves both perspectives: tiredness as a noun and being very tired as an adjective. This is transparent Malay word formation rather than an abbreviation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 letih“累”放进 ke-...-an 的状态框里：ke + letih + an，就是“疲劳状态／累得不行”。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将 layak“合适；合资格”名词化；词根拼写不变。输入资料同时记录不保留及保留词根末尾喉塞音的读法。

senses.zh_definition: 胜任某项工作或承担某项职责所具备的能力、本领或才干。
senses.en_definition: Ability or competence to perform a task or undertake a responsibility.
senses.ms_definition: Kebolehan, kecekapan, kesanggupan.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 释义的核心，强调胜任能力，并不专指文凭。以下学历及准入义按常见实际用法分列，不能视作 DBP 原有的编号义项。参见 [DBP：kelayakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=kelayakan)。

collocations.zh: 担任领导的资格与能力

senses.zh_definition: 证明教育或专业训练达到一定水平的学历、资历或资格。
senses.en_definition: An academic or professional qualification demonstrating an attained level of education or training.
senses.ms_definition: Taraf pendidikan atau latihan yang dicapai dan diiktiraf sebagai bukti kebolehan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 求职和教育语境中，常指学历或获认可的资格；资格本身与证明资格的证书不是同一概念。本项马来文为综合释义。实际用法参见 [马来西亚学术资格鉴定机构：APEL.Q](https://www2.mqa.gov.my/apel/APEL_Q/index.cfm)。

senses.zh_definition: 因满足规定条件而具有的申请、入学、参赛或享用某项待遇的资格。
senses.en_definition: Eligibility to apply, enter, compete, or receive a benefit by meeting specified requirements.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan memenuhi syarat yang ditetapkan untuk memohon, menyertai atau menerima sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 指符合门槛，不保证最终获选或获得待遇；也不宜一律译成已经确立的权利。本项马来文为综合释义。官方准入语境参见 [教育部：入学申请与资格](https://www.moe.gov.my/index.php/permohonan-kelayakan-permohonan-sekolah)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 询问学历时，Boleh kongsikan kelayakan akademik anda? 比直接质疑 Apa kelayakan awak? 更尊重对方。

etymology.historical_story: Kelayakan shows a productive Malay way of turning an adjective into an abstract noun: layak becomes kelayakan through ke-...-an. In education and employment, that abstract idea is applied to recognized credentials and entry requirements. The formation itself explains the connection between being suitable, having qualifications, and meeting a threshold.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: layak＝合资格；ke-...-an 把“合资格”装进名词框：kelayakan＝资格。

headword.data_note: 规范形式为 ke arah，必须分写。IPA 对应规范短语 ke arah；数据包未提供音节和爪夷文，保留 null。

morphology.formula: ke（介词） + arah（方向） → ke arah；kearah 为误连写
morphology.pattern_note: 此处 ke 是独立介词，不是前缀 ke-，也不存在词缀附加引起的音变。数据包把 kearah 标为词根的分析须纠正。

word_family.gloss: 指向某处的；有明确方向的

senses.zh_definition: 【规范形式 ke arah】朝着；向某个空间方向或目标所在的方向。
senses.en_definition: Towards; in the direction of a place, person, or physical target.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan hala atau jurusan yang dituju oleh pergerakan, pandangan atau sesuatu tindakan.
senses.nuances: 词性 preposition 在此对应整个介词性短语。它强调方向，不保证已经抵达目标。DBP 明确要求 ke arah 分写：[DBP 拼写答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=arah-arah)。本条马来语定义为依据词典编写的释义。

senses.zh_definition: 【规范形式 ke arah】朝着某种目标、状态或发展结果；以某种结果为努力方向。
senses.en_definition: Towards an intended goal, developing condition, or outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan matlamat, keadaan atau hasil yang hendak dicapai melalui sesuatu usaha atau perkembangan.
senses.nuances: 常见于政策、公文和工作规划，表示努力的方向；该短语本身不表示目标已实现。用法依据：[DBP 英马词典中的 towards](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=1&k=arah)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 短语本身语体中性。给陌生人指路时加 sila 或 boleh，例如 Sila berjalan ke arah kaunter。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在聊天、公文和考试中均应写 ke arah。抽象用法适合说明目标；若要明确表示已经到达，应另用相应的到达或完成表达。

etymology.historical_story: The expression ke arah combines a preposition of direction with a noun meaning direction or aim. Its spatial meaning also supports abstract expressions about progress towards a goal. The joined spelling kearah does not represent a separate inherited word: DBP explicitly requires the preposition and the following noun to be written separately.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ke 是“向”，arah 是“方向”：向某方向走，两部分各站一格，写成 ke arah。

morphology.pattern_note: 整体借入的词根；词尾 -si 不是此词中的马来语派生后缀。未核实马来西亚标准语派生词，因此不补造词族。

senses.zh_definition: 为达到某种目标、取得某种结果或促成发展而必须具备或满足的条件。
senses.en_definition: A requirement or prerequisite that must be met to achieve an outcome.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang perlu dimiliki atau dilakukan supaya dapat mencapai atau memperoleh sesuatu; syarat yang menjadi asas sesuatu perkembangan.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标为 IB，即印度尼西亚用语。此义相当于 syarat；马来西亚一般公文通常使用 syarat 更自然。不要将此处的“条件要求”与第二义的“实际状况”混淆。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107916&keyword=kondisi)。

senses.zh_definition: 人、事物或社会在某一时刻所处的状态、情况或境况。
senses.en_definition: The state or circumstances in which someone or something exists.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan; kedudukan.
senses.nuances: 此义描述实际状态，不表示必须满足的要求。带有印度尼西亚语色彩；马来西亚一般表达常用 keadaan，例如 keadaan ekonomi、keadaan fizikal。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107916&keyword=kondisi)。

etymology.historical_story: Kondisi reflects the adaptation of Dutch conditie into Indonesian. A study of nineteenth-century newspapers records kondisi in an 1869 issue of Biang Lala, illustrating how Dutch spellings ending in -tie could become -si. Its two meanings, requirement and state, survive in the Malay dictionary entry, which explicitly labels the word as Indonesian usage. [Historical study](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1398/files/5.%20Mahdi.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kondisi 与英语 condition 联想：既可指“要满足的条件”，也可指“目前的状况”。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将 pasti 的“确定”性质名词化；词根保持不变。保留词包分节 ke.pas.tian，音标中的 i.a 表示相邻元音分读。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal pasti; ketentuan.
senses.nuances: 是名词，常见于 mendapat kepastian、memberikan kepastian 和 untuk kepastian。着重疑问得到明确答复；pengesahan 更突出确认行为或正式确认，jaminan 更突出保证。义项依据：[Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kepastian)。

etymology.historical_story: Kepastian shows how Malay turns a quality into an abstract noun: pasti means certain, while ke-...-an names certainty itself. Compare memastikan, which concerns making sure, with kepastian, the settled state or definite answer being sought. This productive relationship explains the modern word without requiring an unverified story about the earlier origin of pasti.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pasti 是“确定”，ke-...-an 把它装进名词框：kepastian 就是“确定性、准话”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词末 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。写作义加 meN- 或 peN- 时，词首 k 脱落：mengarang、pengarang。海洋义、编排义和时间义应分开记忆。

senses.zh_definition: 编排、串缀；引申为写作或创作。

senses.zh_definition: 等会儿；稍后；将来某时。

senses.ms_definition: Pada masa akan datang; sebentar lagi; nanti.
senses.nuances: 常用于口语，也可放在警告后果的分句中。正式时间安排宜用稍明确的时间表达。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish several words spelled karang. One concerns coral, another arrangement and composition, and another future time. Within the composition family, arranging flowers or beads offers a memorable parallel to arranging words into a story. That parallel is a learning aid, not proof that the coral and time meanings share the same historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三个画面分开记：海里的 karang 是珊瑚；把词语串起来是 mengarang；聊天说 karang 是“等会儿”。

senses.ms_definition: Nama wilayah sejarah dan geografi di bahagian utara anak benua India, dalam kawasan Himalaya; boleh merujuk kepada Lembah Kashmir atau kawasan yang lebih luas mengikut konteks.

etymology.historical_story: Kashmir is an inherited regional name used internationally, rather than a word formed with Malay affixes. Its cultural associations include a long tradition of working fine wool. A British Library drawing from around 1860 depicts a Kashmiri woman spinning wool, illustrating the craft history that helps connect the place name with shawls and textiles in readers' minds. [British Library](https://searcharchives.bl.uk/?q=040-003271302&sort=hierarchy)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 kash-mir，先联想“克什米尔的山谷与披肩”；把它整体记作地名，不拆成马来语词根。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为借入词根记忆，不拆成 kon- 与 -tak。派生 mengontakkan 时，meN- 变为 meng-，词根首音 k 脱落，并添加 -kan。

word_family.gloss: 使接触；接通；使建立联系

senses.zh_definition: 在某项事务中能够提供帮助、信息、支持或引介的熟人；人脉。
senses.en_definition: An acquaintance who can provide assistance, information, support, or introductions.
senses.ms_definition: Kenalan yang boleh membantu seseorang mendapatkan maklumat, sokongan atau bantuan dalam sesuatu urusan.
senses.nuances: 此义指具体的人或人脉资源，不只是电话号码。menggunakan kontak 可指正常业务联系，也可能因上下文带有借关系办事的意味。[DBP：kontak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kontak)。

senses.zh_definition: 人与人或机构之间的联系、联络关系。
senses.en_definition: Communication or a continuing connection between people or organizations.
senses.ms_definition: Hubungan atau perhubungan antara seseorang dengan seseorang yang lain atau antara pihak-pihak tertentu.
senses.nuances: 常见于 hilang kontak 等表达。正式文字可根据语义使用 hubungan 或 perhubungan；不要把名词 kontak 直接当作所有场合通用的“联系某人”动词。[DBP：kontak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kontak)。

senses.zh_definition: 物体或身体之间的接触；直接接触的状态。
senses.en_definition: Physical touching or the state of being in direct contact.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan sesuatu bersentuh dengan sesuatu yang lain; sentuhan.
senses.nuances: 用于接触这一物理关系。技术或专业文件应沿用所属领域的固定术语；日常表达中 sentuhan 或 bersentuhan 往往更直接。[DBP：kontak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kontak)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 分享他人联系方式前宜征求本人同意。联系上司或客户时，用 menghubungi，例如 Saya akan menghubungi puan，表达更稳妥。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies kontak as a borrowing from English. Its dictionary senses connect three familiar experiences: knowing someone useful, keeping communication open, and physically touching something. This range makes the word useful across business and everyday interaction. The English spelling contact is adapted as kontak in Malay; the entry does not establish a borrowing date. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kontak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 contact 的拼写换成 kontak：认识的人、保持的联系、实际的接触，核心都是“连上”。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代“深度”义由 dalam 加 ke-...-an 构成，表示性质或状态；词根音形不变。输入中的 kedalam 不是这一现代派生词的正确词根。古典“宫廷”义另列，不能仅凭现代构词公式推定其历史形成过程。

etymology.historical_story: Modern kedalaman transparently combines dalam with ke-...-an to name depth as a property. DBP also records a classical palace sense, alongside an archaic meaning of being excessively deep. These meanings illustrate why dictionary entries need register labels: a modern measurement report and a classical court narrative can use the same spelling with different interpretations. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=kedalaman).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dalam 是“深”，ke-...-an 把性质变成名词：深 → 深度。另记古典义：宫廷。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect keluli with the established material names waja and besi baja. For a learner, this creates a bridge between workshop vocabulary and modern construction or kitchenware. The everyday phrase keluli tahan karat adds a specific property to the material name. The supplied evidence does not establish a donor language, so no foreign origin is asserted here.

etymology.historical_story: Kapas belongs to an old Asian vocabulary of cotton and textiles. Research on South Asian influence connects Malay kapas with Sanskrit karpāsa and related Middle Indo-Aryan forms. Its history reflects contact between languages as well as knowledge of useful plants. In modern Malay, the same everyday word links the growing plant, its fibres, and familiar textile expressions. [Research on South Asian lexical influence](https://brill.com/downloadpdf/book/9789004529458/BP000002.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 表示使事物变得整齐、妥当；首音节 e 读 /ə/，加后缀时词根不变。原包 headword.jawi 的 کمس 实为 kemas 的拼写，依请求原样保留；完整 kemaskan 按构词拼写应为 کمسکن。主动式 meN- + kemas + -kan → mengemaskan，词首 k 被鼻音替代。

senses.nuances: 常用于指令 Kemaskan bilik，也用于 Bilik itu sudah saya kemaskan。正式主动句用 Saya mengemaskan bilik。不是“更新资料”的通用表达；“更新”通常用 kemas kini。[DBP：kemaskan 的语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kemas+kan)

senses.zh_definition: 整理仪容或衣着，使自己看起来整洁得体。

senses.ms_definition: Merapikan penampilan diri atau membetulkan pakaian supaya kelihatan terurus.
senses.nuances: 常见于 kemaskan diri；可指整理衣着、头发等，不必然表示洗澡。与房间整理同属“使整齐”的意义延伸。[DBP：mengemaskan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mengemaskan)

senses.zh_definition: 耗尽钱财或财产；对应 mengemaskan 的较少见词典义。
senses.en_definition: To use up or exhaust money or property; a less common sense of mengemaskan.
senses.ms_definition: Menghabiskan wang atau harta benda.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 为 mengemaskan 记录的另一义，不能把普通的“收拾东西”理解成耗尽财产。无前缀形式通常须置于适当的被动结构中。以下为展示此义的语境搭配，不是高频日常表达。[DBP：mengemaskan 第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mengemaskan)

etymology.historical_story: Kemaskan illustrates a productive Malay way of turning a quality into an action. Kemas describes an orderly or neat state; adding -kan expresses bringing something into that state. The form suits instructions and certain passive constructions, while mengemaskan supplies the corresponding prefixed active verb. This grammatical relationship explains its everyday usefulness without requiring a speculative story about an ancient borrowing. [DBP grammatical guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kemas+kan)

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留为无词缀形式；在此按口语疑问助词 ke 的非规范聊天拼写分析。末尾 r 通常不表示独立的 /r/ 音，也不是后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 吗；是吗。用于询问是否属实或请求确认，是口语 ke 的非规范拼写。
senses.en_definition: An informal spelling of the question particle ke, used to ask a yes–no question or seek confirmation.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi partikel percakapan ke yang digunakan untuk menanyakan atau mendapatkan kepastian tentang sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 按马来西亚聊天语境解释，不视为独立的规范书面词。常放在句末；betul ker? 可依语气表示普通确认或惊讶。正式表达可改用 adakah、相应的 -kah 结构或完整问句。ker 与 ke 的拼写对应见 [SMS 拼写实例](https://englishbagus.blogspot.com/2010/)。本条马来文释义为编辑性说明，并非 DBP 原文。

senses.zh_definition: 还是。用于列举供选择的选项，是口语 ke 在选择问句中的非规范拼写。
senses.en_definition: An informal alternative marker corresponding to ke, used when offering choices in a question.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi ke dalam pertanyaan yang mengemukakan pilihan; dalam bahasa baku lazimnya digantikan dengan atau.

senses.zh_definition: 胶囊；装有一定剂量药物的小型可溶性囊壳，也指连同内容物在内的胶囊制剂。

senses.ms_definition: Struktur berbentuk kantung yang menghasilkan dan mengandungi spora pada lumut.

etymology.historical_story: Kapsul belongs to an international vocabulary associated with enclosing containers. Its English counterpart, capsule, traces through French to Latin capsula, meaning a small box. That image connects medicine shells, anatomical coverings, botanical structures and spacecraft compartments. The ultimate Latin relationship is clear, but the supplied evidence does not establish the immediate route into Malay. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/capsule).

etymology.historical_story: The international name koala ultimately comes from Dharug, an Aboriginal language of the Sydney region. Historical records preserve forms such as gula and kūlā for the animal. Its journey into English and other languages carries a trace of Indigenous knowledge, while its familiar bear-like appearance explains why learners sometimes mistake its biological identity. [State Library of Queensland](https://www.slq.qld.gov.au/blog/aboriginal-loanwords-english); [State Library of New South Wales](https://bayala.sl.nsw.gov.au/word/koala-2)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: koala 音近“考拉”：想象一只考拉靠着树干、拉住树枝，记住树栖有袋动物的形象。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于词尾的强调小品词，不是改变词类的派生后缀；连接时没有词根音变。输入的 کناڤ 对应 kenapa，包含 -lah 的完整形式可写作 کناڤله；headword.jawi 按输入保留。

word_family.gloss: 为什么；附有疑问小品词的形式

senses.zh_definition: 为什么偏偏……；究竟为什么……。在询问原因时带有困惑、懊恼、遗憾或责问等语气。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kenapa yang disertai partikel penegas -lah untuk menanyakan sebab dengan penekanan, misalnya apabila berasa hairan, kesal atau kecewa.
senses.nuances: 马来语语法上属于 kata tanya 加 partikel penegas；adverb 是本结构中对应疑问副词功能的标签。-lah 的作用由语调和语境决定，并不必然表示礼貌。正式报告通常采用 mengapa 或 mengapakah。本释义依据 kenapa 与 -lah 综合编写，不是 DBP 对 kenapalah 的逐字释义。[DBP：kenapa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=kenapa)、[DBP：lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=lah)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP explains kenapa through kena apa, sebab apa and mengapa. Adding the bound particle -lah gives the question extra emphasis without changing its basic request for a reason. In conversation, intonation can turn that question into bewilderment or regret. This is a transparent modern combination, rather than a separate ancient root. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=kenapa)

senses.zh_definition: 混凝土：以水泥、水、砂及碎石等拌合、硬化后形成的建筑材料。

senses.ms_definition: Bahan binaan daripada campuran simen, pasir, batu kelikir dan air.

senses.zh_definition: 具体存在、可感知或具有物质形态的；与抽象相对。

senses.zh_definition: 明确、具体而非含糊的；有实质内容或确实依据的。
senses.en_definition: Definite, specific, or supported by tangible substance rather than vague.
senses.ms_definition: Pasti, jelas dan tidak samar-samar; mempunyai isi atau asas yang nyata.
senses.nuances: 用于建议、行动和证据。bukti konkrit 指实在、有力的证据，不限于物理证物。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 通常把形容词 sesak 转成表示状态的名词；词根拼写保持不变。读音可有词根末尾喉塞音保留的变体。

senses.zh_definition: 人群、车辆或其他事物过度集中，造成空间拥挤或通行不畅的状态。

senses.ms_definition: Keadaan terlalu padat atau sempit sehingga ruang atau pergerakan menjadi terbatas.
senses.nuances: 交通报道中通常指堵塞状态，不表示事故本身；也可指场所或设施过度拥挤。词义依据：[DBP PRPM：kesesakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kesesakan)。

senses.zh_definition: 呼吸或胸部受到阻滞、紧迫的感觉。

senses.zh_definition: 经济、生活或处境上的困窘、拮据。
senses.en_definition: Hardship or straitened circumstances, especially financial difficulty.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan kesempitan atau kesukaran, khususnya dalam hal kewangan dan kehidupan.
senses.nuances: 较偏书面语，现代一般表达也常用 kesempitan wang 或 masalah kewangan。这里的“挤迫”是资源不足带来的处境压力。

senses.zh_definition: 处于十分困顿、窘迫或难以应付的状态。
senses.en_definition: Severely pressed, distressed, or in great difficulty.
senses.ms_definition: Berada dalam keadaan sangat sesak, sukar atau sulit.
senses.nuances: DBP 保留的谓语用法，常见于较旧的叙事文字；现代通常改说 berada dalam kesukaran 或 sangat terdesak。以下为理解此旧式义项的语境搭配，不属于现代高频固定搭配。依据：[DBP PRPM：kesesakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kesesakan)。

etymology.historical_story: Kesesakan grows from sesak, a word connecting crowded space with bodily tightness and difficult circumstances. The circumfix ke-...-an presents these experiences as a condition. Older dictionary examples also preserve a predicative meaning, being severely pressed or distressed. Modern traffic reporting makes the spatial meaning especially familiar, without exhausting the word's broader range. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=kesesakan).

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着代词，在此表示“我的”，不是改变词类的派生后缀；suffix 为模板中的位置分类。两个 k 分别属于 kakak 与 ku，必须保留。资料包 Jawi کاکق 为词根，完整 kakakku 为 کاکقکو；音节可分析为 ka.kak.ku。

senses.en_definition: My elder sister; also, affectionately, an older woman regarded or addressed as a sister.
senses.ms_definition: Saudara perempuanku yang lebih tua; dalam konteks mesra, perempuan lebih tua yang kuanggap atau kusapa sebagai kakak.
senses.nuances: 默认理解为自己的姐姐。kakak 本身也可作为对稍年长女性的亲切称呼，但 kakakku 带有额外的亲密感，不能普遍代替对陌生人的 Kak。正式交谈中 kakak saya 通常更自然。依据：[DBP PRPM：kakak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kakak)、[DBP PRPM：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku)。

senses.zh_definition: 我的哥哥；对应 kakak 在部分文本中的男性年长手足义。
senses.en_definition: My elder brother, in contexts where kakak denotes a male elder sibling.
senses.ms_definition: Saudara lelakiku yang lebih tua, iaitu abangku, apabila kakak digunakan dengan pengertian tersebut.
senses.nuances: DBP《Kamus Dewan》记录 kakak 的“哥哥”义，但现代马来西亚日常用语通常用 abangku 或 abang saya。理解旧文或特定语境时保留此义，不应据此把现代 kakak 一律当作不分性别的称谓。以下为说明语境的组合，非现代高频男性称谓搭配。依据：[DBP PRPM：kakak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kakak)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: -ku 不等于粗鲁，但与 aku 的语体有关；职场口头汇报通常用 kakak saya。亲人聊天、私人叙述、诗歌或致谢文字中 kakakku 很合适。

etymology.historical_story: Malay kinship vocabulary extends beyond biological relatives: kakak can also address an older woman with friendly respect. Kakakku adds the attached pronoun ku, shortened from aku, to express a personal relationship. Kamus Dewan also records an elder-brother meaning for kakak, illustrating why older texts may require context even when modern Malaysian usage strongly suggests a sister. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kakak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kakak 是姐姐，ku 是“我的”：kakak + ku，两个 k 各守一边，合起来就是 kakakku。

etymology.historical_story: Kemahuan grows transparently from mahu, meaning to want or be willing, through the Malay circumfix ke-...-an. The resulting noun turns an everyday intention into something one can discuss: a wish, willingness, or will. The familiar saying “Di mana ada kemahuan, di situ ada jalan” links that inner resolve with finding a way forward.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mahu＝想要；加上 ke-...-an，把“想要”装成一个名词：kemahuan＝愿望、意愿。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整借词使用，无可据此列出的固定派生词族。IPA 是按马来语读法推定，ai 按双元音、j 按 /dʒ/ 处理；日语原词 kaijū 的读音不同。数据包缺少分音节及爪夷拼写，保留 null。

etymology.historical_story: Kaiju represents Japanese kaijū, written 怪獣 and literally meaning 'strange beast'. The term became internationally associated with Japanese screen monsters such as Godzilla, whose first film appeared in 1954. Later productions, including Pacific Rim, used the Japanese word for their own creatures, extending its recognition beyond Japanese cinema and television. [Japanese Agency for Cultural Affairs: What is Kaiju?](https://mediag.bunka.go.jp/article/article-17528/)

senses.nuances: 常见于情感叙述、文学和精神生活讨论。它本身不是抑郁症等医学诊断，也不必然表示无聊。

etymology.historical_story: Kekosongan is transparently formed within Malay from kosong and the noun-forming circumfix ke-...-an. Its meanings connect an unfilled place with an unfulfilled inner life. In administrative language, the empty place becomes a vacant post; in personal writing, the same image describes emotional absence. This account explains its formation and cultural imagery without assigning an unverified ancient origin to kosong.

etymology.historical_story: The base khusus belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of distinction and specificity. Adding Malay -nya produces a familiar expression for narrowing attention: a writer names a broad group, then highlights one part. This combination illustrates how an established loanword participates in Malay word formation and serves everyday explanatory writing, public announcements, and institutional communication.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: khusus 是“特别、专门”；加上 -nya，就像用荧光笔从一大群对象中圈出重点：“尤其是这个”。

etymology.historical_story: Keenam illustrates a productive Malay numbering pattern: ke- turns enam, 'six', into an ordinal. Its meaning concerns position rather than quantity. The related expression keenam-enam instead gathers six members into one complete set. Remembering that contrast connects classroom rankings, chapter numbers, and everyday references to an entire group.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ke- 当作“第”号标签：enam 是六，ke- + enam 就是第六；keenam-enam 则是六个全到齐。

senses.nuances: 具体词类是人称代词，属于名词性成分；-lah 只增加强调。kita 通常包含听者，kami 则排除听者。常见结构为 kitalah yang…。输入包中的 Jawi کيت 对应基词 kita；完整附加 -lah 的形式为 کيتله。[DBP：kita](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kita)

collocations.zh: 我们正是承前启后的一代
collocations.en: we are the generation that will carry the legacy forward

senses.zh_definition: 就是我；是我呀。在某些熟人交流或地域用法中，强调以 kita 自称的说话者本人。
senses.en_definition: It is me; an emphatic use of kita referring to the speaker alone in some familiar or regional usage.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk penegasan bagi kita apabila kata ganti tersebut digunakan dengan maksud saya atau aku dalam konteks tertentu.
senses.nuances: kita 的单数自称义有词典依据，但不是所有马来西亚人的通用习惯。必须由具体对话确认，不能把所有 kitalah 都译成“我”。正式场合需要明确单数身份时，通常用 sayalah。[DBP：kita 的单数义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=kita)

collocations.en: I'm the one who called earlier
I'm the one waiting for you

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sebagai anggota masyarakat, kitalah yang bertanggungjawab memelihara keharmonian negara.
dual_scenarios.zh: 作为社会成员，维护国家和谐正是我们共同的责任。
dual_scenarios.en: As members of society, we ourselves are responsible for preserving national harmony.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kitalah yang kena kemas nanti, jadi jangan sepahkan barang kat sini.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kitalah yang perlu mengemas nanti, jadi jangan menyelerakkan barang di sini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 等下还不是得咱们来收拾，所以别把东西乱放在这儿。
dual_scenarios.en: We're the ones who'll have to clean up later, so don't leave things lying around here.
spoken_features: kena 在此表示“得、必须”，标准表达可用 perlu。
kat 对应 di。
sepahkan 是省略前缀的口语动词，标准形式为 menyelerakkan。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Siapa nak kemas bilik ni lepas majlis?
messages.ms_standard: Siapakah yang akan mengemas bilik ini selepas majlis?
messages.zh: 活动结束后谁来收拾这个房间？
messages.en: Who's going to tidy this room after the event?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kitalah yang kena kemas nanti. Letak kotak kat tepi dulu, senang sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Kitalah yang perlu mengemas nanti. Letakkan kotak di tepi dahulu supaya kerja mengemas lebih mudah.

messages.en: We are. Put the boxes to one side first; that'll make it easier.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 倡议、演讲和团队讨论中可表达共同担当。使用 kita 会把听者纳入责任范围；尚未取得共识时，过强的强调可能显得替别人作主。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合共同身份、共同任务和群体责任。向不参与任务的人说明己方工作时，应根据所指群体选择 kami 或 kamilah。单数自称用法宜沿用熟悉的关系与地域习惯。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 倡议、演讲和团队讨论中可表达共同担当。使用 kita 会把听者纳入责任范围；尚未取得共识时，过强的强调可能显得替别人作主。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合共同身份、共同任务和群体责任。向不参与任务的人说明己方工作时，应根据所指群体选择 kami 或 kamilah。单数自称用法宜沿用熟悉的关系与地域习惯。

etymology.historical_story: Malay makes social inclusion visible through its pronouns: kita normally embraces the listener, whereas kami leaves the listener outside the group. Adding -lah brings that included group into focus. The dictionary also preserves kita as a singular self-reference in certain contexts, showing how one familiar form can express either collective identity or a speaker's individual voice.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kita＝“咱们”，lah＝强调聚光灯：kitalah yang… 就是“正是咱们……”。

morphology.pattern_note: 名词化后缀 -an 接在 kunjung 后，词根末尾 /ŋ/ 保留。输入包将派生词误标为词根，此处依据实际构词修正。

senses.zh_definition: 到某地参观或拜访某人的活动；访问、到访或来访。
senses.en_definition: A visit to a person or place.
senses.ms_definition: Hasil berkunjung atau mengunjungi; lawatan.
senses.nuances: 是名词，不能直接充当“拜访”的谓语；“我拜访他”用 Saya mengunjunginya。“kunjungan hormat”指礼节性拜会；“kunjungan kilat”指短暂访问，通常未经事先安排。词义及词族参见 [DBP：kunjung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kunjung)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengarah menerima kunjungan hormat daripada wakil universiti itu pagi tadi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主任于今天上午接待了该大学代表的礼节性拜访。
dual_scenarios.en: The director received a courtesy call from the university's representatives this morning.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Terima kasih sebab datang tadi, kunjungan korang memang buat mak gembira lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Terima kasih kerana datang tadi. Kunjungan kamu semua benar-benar menggembirakan ibu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 谢谢你们刚才过来，你们来一趟，妈妈可开心了。
dual_scenarios.en: Thanks for coming over earlier. Your visit really made Mum happy.
spoken_features: korang 是 kamu semua 的口语形式
sebab 在口语中引出原因，标准对应句使用 kerana
mak 是 ibu 的日常称呼
lah 增添亲切、强调的语气；kunjungan 本身仍带一定书面感

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Terima kasih sebab datang tadi. Mak seronok betul dengan kunjungan korang.
messages.ms_standard: Terima kasih kerana datang tadi. Ibu sangat gembira dengan kunjungan kamu semua.
messages.zh: 谢谢你们刚才来，妈妈见到你们特别开心。
messages.en: Thanks for coming over earlier. Mum was really happy you all visited.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Sama-sama! Kami pun dah lama nak jumpa mak kau. Nanti kami datang lagi lah.
messages.ms_standard: Sama-sama! Kami juga sudah lama ingin berjumpa dengan ibu kamu. Kami akan datang lagi nanti.
messages.zh: 不客气！我们也早就想见你妈妈了，下次再来。
messages.en: You're welcome! We'd been wanting to see your mum for ages. We'll come over again.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向机构、长辈或职场上级表达拜访意愿时，kunjungan hormat 适合礼节性场合；普通朋友之间通常直接说 datang 或 datang melawat。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: kunjungan 不表示可以随时登门。私人拜访宜先询问方便的时间；礼节性拜会通常需要预约。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向机构、长辈或职场上级表达拜访意愿时，kunjungan hormat 适合礼节性场合；普通朋友之间通常直接说 datang 或 datang melawat。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: kunjungan 不表示可以随时登门。私人拜访宜先询问方便的时间；礼节性拜会通常需要预约。

etymology.historical_story: Kunjungan is transparently formed from kunjung and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its family links the visitor, pengunjung, with the activities berkunjung and mengunjungi. In Malaysian public life, kunjungan hormat names a courtesy call, showing how an ordinary visit can become a formal expression of respect. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kunjung).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“kunjung 去拜访，接上 -an 变成一次访问”；pengunjung 则是来访的人。

morphology.pattern_note: 借入后作为完整词根使用；ko- 与 -al 在这里均不是马来语词缀，第二音节的 e 读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 准下士；低于下士一级的军警衔，属复合词

senses.zh_definition: 下士：军队中比准下士高一级、比列兵高两级的军衔；亦指持有此军衔的军人。
senses.en_definition: The military rank of corporal, above lance corporal; also its holder.
senses.ms_definition: Pangkat dalam pasukan tentera yang setingkat lebih tinggi daripada lans koperal dan dua tingkat lebih tinggi daripada prebet.
senses.nuances: 指具体军衔或其持有者，不等于所有士兵或所有军官。中文译名在不同地区的军衔体系中可能不同，应保留其相对等级。依据 [DBP：koperal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=koperal)。

senses.zh_definition: 警察下士：警队中比警察准下士高一级的警衔；亦指持有此警衔的警员。
senses.en_definition: The police rank of corporal, above lance corporal; also its holder.
senses.ms_definition: Pangkat dalam pasukan polis yang setingkat lebih tinggi daripada lans koperal polis.
senses.nuances: 与军队义共享拼写，须由 polis、balai 等语境确定。不能简单译为警长，因为其他警衔可能使用这一中文译名。依据 [DBP：koperal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=koperal)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Anggota tentera itu dinaikkan pangkat kepada koperal setelah menunjukkan prestasi yang cemerlang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该军人因表现优异而获晋升为下士。
dual_scenarios.en: The soldier was promoted to corporal after demonstrating excellent performance.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Abang saya sudah dinaikkan pangkat kepada koperal.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我哥已经升下士啦！
dual_scenarios.en: My brother's been promoted to corporal!
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah
naik pangkat jadi 是口语表达，标准对应句使用 dinaikkan pangkat kepada
aku 用于熟人之间
lah 在这里增添兴奋、告知的语气

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Abang aku dah jadi koperal! Dia baru bagitahu kat rumah tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Abang saya sudah dinaikkan pangkat kepada koperal. Dia baru memberitahu kami di rumah tadi.
messages.zh: 我哥升下士了！他刚才在家才告诉我们。
