etymology.historical_story: Kutahu illustrates Malay’s compact first-person expression: ku-, the bound form of aku, attaches directly to tahu. Rather than creating a new meaning for knowing, the combination identifies the speaker as the knower. Its compact shape suits verse and intimate narration; a poem published in Dewan Sastera provides an attested literary example. [Dewan Sastera](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/03/DEWAN-SASTERA-APRIL-2025-2rv7ge.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ku 想成“我”，tahu 记成“知道”：ku + tahu，一口气说“我知道”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + kuatir → kuatir；马来西亚标准拼写：khuatir
morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不可拆成 kuat 加其他成分。此处 IPA 对应输入变体；标准拼写 khuatir 保留 kh。以下词族采用标准词形，不是直接在 kuatir 上加词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 担心的；因预想到可能出现不好的情况而感到不安。马来西亚标准书写使用 khuatir。
senses.en_definition: Worried or apprehensive about something undesirable that may happen; a variant corresponding to standard Malaysian Malay khuatir.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk varian bagi khuatir: berasa bimbang atau gelisah kerana menjangka sesuatu yang tidak diingini mungkin berlaku.
senses.nuances: 描述忧虑状态，不表示主动恐吓别人，也不必然表示惊恐。马来西亚正式写作宜用 khuatir；印尼语规范词形为 khawatir，KBBI 将 kuatir 导向该词。此处马来文释义为依据词典义项整理的释义，并非 DBP 原文。[DBP：khuatir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=khuatir)；[KBBI：kuatir](https://kbbi.kemendikdasmen.go.id/entri/kuatir)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies standard khuatir as an Arabic borrowing. Across Malay and Indonesian writing, related spellings include khuatir, khawatir and kuatir. Their shared association with worry survives these spelling differences. For learners, this history explains why a familiar expression in Indonesian media may need a different spelling in a Malaysian report, without acquiring a different basic meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuatir 和标准拼写 khuatir 配对记：心里反复想着“会不会出事”，就是担忧。不要因为开头像 kuat，就误解成“强壮”。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story of kasutnya is grammatical: Malay attaches a short pronoun to an everyday noun. Kasut names footwear, while -nya points back to a person already understood. The resulting form leaves gender and number to context, explaining why English translations may require choices that the Malay word itself does not make. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ganti+nama+diri)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kasut 是“鞋”，接上 -nya 就给鞋挂上“他／她的”领属标签：kasut + nya。

senses.en_definition: Your physical strength or capacity for exertion.

senses.zh_definition: 你的坚强、实力或优势，包括意志韧性、影响力和使你能够应对挑战的长处。
senses.en_definition: Your fortitude, power, or particular strength.
senses.ms_definition: Keteguhan hati, kemampuan, pengaruh atau kelebihan yang ada pada dirimu.

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. The adjective kuat becomes the abstract noun kekuatan through ke-...-an. The attached pronoun -mu then makes that strength yours. The same construction supports both bodily power and personal resilience, allowing a single expression to describe physical effort, encouragement, or an individual's advantages.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kuat＝强；ke-...-an 把“强”变成“力量”；-mu 把力量交给“你”：kekuatanmu＝你的力量。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan separates kelibat into three homonymous entries: a double-bladed paddle, a Jakarta regional expression for involvement, and a fleeting visual appearance. Their shared spelling does not establish a shared origin. The dictionary record preserves these distinct meanings, but the consulted entry does not explain their deeper historical relationship. etymology.historical_story: Kepten belongs to the Malay borrowing family associated with English captain and the spelling kapten. In Malaysia, institutional usage gives kepten a particularly clear naval and maritime identity. The navy lists Kepten as equivalent to an army colonel. This illustrates how related spellings can acquire distinct professional conventions within the same language. [Royal Malaysian Navy rank table](https://pusmas.navy.mil.my/images/pdf/Majalah%20Samudera/2005/BIL_01-_2005.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Konon belongs to the language of reports and storytelling: the speaker passes on an account without personally guaranteeing it. With -nya, kononnya can introduce a traditional tale or distance the speaker from somebody's claim. The same distance becomes irony when a promise fails, explaining how a storytelling expression also works naturally in teasing conversation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kononnya，先在心里加一对引号：“人家是这么说的。”有无讽刺，再听语气、看事实。

etymology.historical_story: The keluaran family organises meaning around something coming out from a source. A factory produces goods, a publisher releases a magazine, and an institution sends trained people into society. Malay applies the resulting noun to all three. Economic terminology extends this source-and-result relationship to the measured output of an entire economy.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: luar 是“外面”，keluar 是“出来”，keluaran 就记成“从某处出来的成果”：工厂的产品、出版社的刊物、学校培养的人。

etymology.historical_story: Miskin is an Arabic loan that became an ordinary Malay word for being poor. Malay then supplied its own productive ke-...-an frame to form kemiskinan, the condition of poverty. The result illustrates how a borrowed base can become fully integrated into Malay grammar, supporting discussion of everyday hardship as well as public welfare.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: miskin 是“穷”，ke-...-an 给它套上“状态框”：kemiskinan 就是“贫穷这种状态”。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将形容词 masyhur 名词化，表示闻名的状态；词根保持不变，sy 表示 /ʃ/。

etymology.historical_story: The base masyhur is an Arabic loan meaning famous or widely known. Malay places its own ke-...-an frame around that borrowed base to name the condition of fame. The word therefore illustrates how an imported adjective becomes part of a productive Malay word family. DBP also illustrates it through Melaka's reputation as a trading centre. [DBP: masyhur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=masyhur)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: masyhur＝有名；套上 ke-...-an，就把“有名”装成一种状态：名气、声望。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是表示第二人称领属的后附代词，严格说属于附着语素，而非派生后缀；此处按字段归入 suffix。末尾 k 通常读 /ʔ/。输入未提供音节，故保留 null；通常可分 ka.kak.mu。所给 Jawi کاکق 仅对应词根，完整形式可写作 کاکقمو。

etymology.historical_story: Kakakmu combines a kinship term with the shortened second-person pronoun mu. Malay kinship vocabulary also works beyond biological families: kakak can create respectful familiarity with an older woman. The attached pronoun identifies the person in relation to the addressee. This grammatical combination explains the whole form without requiring a separate borrowing story or an invented ancient root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kakak＝姐姐，-mu＝你的；两块直接拼接：kakakmu＝你的姐姐。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的行业及地理用词，新闻、工作报告和日常交流均适用；称呼相关人员可用 pekerja kuari 或 pengusaha kuari。

etymology.historical_story: Kuari was borrowed from English quarry, retaining the meaning of a place where stone is extracted. Its Malay spelling makes the borrowed sound recognizable through local spelling conventions. The word also participates in Malay grammar: menguari means to quarry, showing how an imported industrial noun can become the base of a locally formed verb. [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/kuari), [DBP derivation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kuari)

morphology.pattern_note: 词根末尾 n 保留，后接表示 /ɲ/ 的 ny，因此拼写为 nnya；-nya 是附着于前词的指代成分。音节按完整词形补全；数据包爪夷文为词根，完整词形为 کاننڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Kanannya combines kanan with the attached reference marker -nya. The cultural interest lies in the meanings collected around kanan: alongside physical direction, Malay uses it for senior rank and for a trusted helper in orang kanan. These meanings coexist in the dictionary; they should not be mistaken for evidence of a particular historical sequence of development. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=kanan)

senses.zh_definition: 使物件或连接处变紧；拧紧、拉紧或束紧。

senses.zh_definition: 使规则、条件或限制更加严格。

senses.ms_definition: Jadikan peraturan, syarat atau sekatan lebih tegas.
senses.nuances: 用于政策、资格要求或制度执行；表示提高严格程度，不必然表示新增禁令。一般主动陈述句用 mengetatkan。

etymology.historical_story: Ketatkan illustrates a productive Malay pattern rather than a securely documented borrowing. Ketat describes tightness, while -kan turns that quality into an action affecting something else. The same vocabulary moves from tightening a physical fastening to making rules or supervision more rigorous. Its older ultimate origin is not established by the supplied evidence. [DBP: ketat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=ketat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ketat 是“紧”，加 -kan 就是“让它紧”：螺丝拧紧，规定收紧，管控加强。

etymology.historical_story: Club vocabulary illustrates how neighbouring languages adapt international words differently. Indonesian dictionaries record klub, while Malaysian Malay dictionaries record kelab. DBP identifies English as the source of kelab. Both forms refer to organised associations and their meeting places, but their spelling and pronunciation follow different national conventions. [Sources: KBBI](https://kbbi.kemendikdasmen.go.id/entri/klub), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175364&keyword=kelab).

etymology.historical_story: Knight comes from Old English cniht, a word associated with a boy, servant, or military attendant. Its later meanings reflect a rise in social status: the attendant became a mounted warrior and a holder of an honour. Modern English also uses the word for a chess piece and for the act of conferring knighthood. [Merriam-Webster：knight](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/knight)

etymology.historical_story: Ketahuan belongs to the Malay word family built around tahu, meaning to know. Its ke-...-an formation shifts attention toward something being known, discovered, or evident. The dictionary preserves all three meanings, so translating every occurrence as being caught would be misleading. The word can describe an identity becoming known, a fact emerging, or uncertainty when used in a negative construction. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ketahuan)

etymology.historical_story: Kura illustrates how a dictionary can preserve an unfamiliar anatomical word beside a more familiar everyday term. Kamus Dewan defines this sense simply through limpa. That evidence establishes its meaning, but does not establish a borrowing language or a dated origin. The similar-looking animal expression kura-kura should therefore be learned separately. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kura).

etymology.historical_story: Keburukan is transparently formed from buruk with the Malay circumfix ke-...-an. The dictionary records both shortcomings and bad matters concerning people or things. This explains its two familiar settings: weighing advantages against disadvantages, and discussing someone's faults. The same formation connects an everyday judgment, buruk, with an abstract noun. No deeper origin is asserted. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=keburukan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: buruk 是“坏”，ke-…-an 把它装成“坏的方面”：keburukan 就是缺点、弊端或坏事。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates a living Malay grammatical habit rather than a separately established word origin. Kelakar supplies the idea of joking or amusement, and the attached particle -lah adds emphasis. DBP distinguishes such particles from derivational affixes. The resulting expression can sound warmly amused or sharply sarcastic, depending on the speaker's delivery.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kelakar 负责“好笑”，-lah 负责把说话人的语气带出来：kelakarlah，就像“真逗啊”。

etymology.historical_story: English key descends through Middle English from Old English cǣg. The familiar object that opens a lock provides a useful image for understanding figurative expressions about access, solutions, and success. Modern English also uses the word for keyboard controls and data entry. These meanings explain the examples here, without establishing key as an officially accepted Malay headword. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/key)

etymology.historical_story: Kaulder illustrates how fictional names enter multilingual texts without becoming ordinary vocabulary. In The Last Witch Hunter, it names a warrior cursed with immortality. Malay discussion can retain that spelling while adding phrases such as watak Kaulder. This identifies an attested cultural referent, but does not establish the name's linguistic origin or the intended referent of every occurrence. [Film synopsis](https://www.tributemovies.com/movie/The-Last-Witch-Hunter/109631/)

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语句子中作为完整名称使用，不按马来语词缀拆分。英语读音中的 /ŋɡ/ 包含鼻音后接 /ɡ/，词尾为 /əl/。

senses.zh_definition: 一种北欧烘焙食品，常呈扭结形、环形或椭圆形；具体面团、馅料与甜咸做法因地区而异。
senses.en_definition: A Scandinavian baked item, often twisted or ring-shaped, with regional variations in dough and filling.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pastri atau roti Scandinavia yang lazimnya berbentuk simpulan, gelang atau bujur, dengan adunan dan inti yang berbeza mengikut tradisi setempat.
senses.nuances: 这是外语食品名称的马来语说明，不是 DBP 官方释义。不能把所有 kringle 都限定为同一种甜馅酥皮点心；以下为描述性组合，不声称是高频马来语搭配。[Kringle 概述](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kringle)。

senses.zh_definition: 蛋白质中的一种紧凑结构域，具有由三个二硫键稳定的特征性环状折叠，可见于纤溶酶原等蛋白质。
senses.en_definition: A compact protein domain with a characteristic looped fold stabilized by three disulfide bonds.
senses.ms_definition: Domain protein padat dengan lipatan bergelung yang distabilkan oleh tiga ikatan disulfida, seperti yang terdapat dalam plasminogen.
senses.nuances: 限生物化学及结构生物学语境；domain kringle 指蛋白质结构域，不是食品。此处为术语说明，未声称属于 DBP 核定译名。[Oxford University Research Archive](https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid%3A36904eb5-3e22-4a62-86b1-f7cf1fa0cce6)。

etymology.historical_story: Kringle belongs to a Scandinavian baking tradition whose name is associated with rings and curved shapes. The same food name later supplied a vivid comparison in protein science: compact, disulfide-linked protein domains were called kringles because their looped structures resembled the pastry. The culinary and biochemical meanings therefore share a visual connection. [Danish historical dictionary](https://ny.ordnet.dk/ko/ordbog/Kringle), [research thesis](https://www.collectionscanada.gc.ca/obj/s4/f2/dsk3/ftp04/NQ56098.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Komisen was borrowed from English commission and adapted to Malay spelling and pronunciation. Its everyday commercial meaning centres on paying someone for helping to complete a sale or provide an agency service. This makes it a familiar word in sales conversations: the seller's success and the intermediary's reward are linked through the transaction. [UNIMAS linguistic study](https://publisher.unimas.my/ojs/index.php/ILS/article/download/4413/1655/16665)

etymology.historical_story: Kening connects facial anatomy with the language of gesture. Kamus Dewan records expressions involving raised eyebrows and even older descriptions of early morning based on the sun's position. It also preserves a Minangkabau meaning, 'forehead'. These records show the word's cultural range; they do not establish a particular borrowing history. [DBP lexical record](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=kening)

etymology.historical_story: Koran comes from Dutch courant, a historical word for a newspaper. Its spelling preserves a trace of Dutch linguistic influence in the Indonesian archipelago. The connection is memorable: news circulates, and courant belongs to a European word family associated with running or being current. Malaysian Malay generally uses surat khabar or akhbar for the same everyday object. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/koran#Malay).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ko-ran 联想成“摊开两栏新闻”：看到报纸的新闻栏，就想起 koran。此联想仅用于记忆，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Konvensyen belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English convention. The English word came through French from Latin conventio, meaning a meeting or agreement, related to convenire, to assemble or agree. That historical connection helps explain the Malay word's two central meanings: people gathering to deliberate, and countries establishing an agreement. [English word history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/convention).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 同属第一人称表达，适合亲近关系和文学自述。面对长辈、上司、客户或政府机构时，kehidupan saya 通常更稳妥；文学中的 -ku 并不因形式较亲密就自动失礼。[DBP 正式交际称谓说明](https://pdigital.dbp.gov.my/storage/uploads/6823ed2951d19_buku.pdf)。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于日记、个人故事、歌词式表达和好友间谈心。在正式报道中，可保留人物自述引文里的 kehidupanku；正式直接交谈则优先使用 kehidupan saya。涉及私生活或困难经历时，应尊重对方愿意分享的范围。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 同属第一人称表达，适合亲近关系和文学自述。面对长辈、上司、客户或政府机构时，kehidupan saya 通常更稳妥；文学中的 -ku 并不因形式较亲密就自动失礼。[DBP 正式交际称谓说明](https://pdigital.dbp.gov.my/storage/uploads/6823ed2951d19_buku.pdf)。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于日记、个人故事、歌词式表达和好友间谈心。在正式报道中，可保留人物自述引文里的 kehidupanku；正式直接交谈则优先使用 kehidupan saya。涉及私生活或困难经历时，应尊重对方愿意分享的范围。

etymology.historical_story: Kehidupanku illustrates how Malay builds personal meaning through familiar grammatical pieces. Hidup supplies the idea of living; ke-…-an forms kehidupan, referring to life or its circumstances. The attached pronoun -ku, shortened from aku, makes that life the speaker's own. The resulting expression naturally lends itself to autobiography, intimate reflection and accounts of personal change. [DBP on attached pronouns](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=singkat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 hidup“活着”，再把末尾 ku 认作 aku“我”：kehidupan 是“生活”，kehidupanku 就是“我的生活、我的人生”。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词无词缀；与表示给予、允许或使令的 kasih III 对应。kasi 的拼写和读音均不含词尾 h。

word_family.gloss: 相关形式 kasih III：给；允许；使
口语：给予；允许（此处限 kasi I 的派生义）

senses.zh_definition: 给；把物品、金钱等交给某人。
senses.en_definition: To give or hand something to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Beri; bagi.
senses.nuances: 口语用法，对应标准语 beri 或 memberikan。本条处理输入所指的 kasi I；词典收录并不表示它适合正式行文。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kasi)

senses.zh_definition: 使；让某物变成某种状态，或使某个结果发生。
senses.en_definition: To cause something to happen or make something become a particular way.
senses.ms_definition: Membuat supaya; menjadikan.
senses.nuances: 后接状态词时构成口语使令结构，如 kasi bersih（弄干净）。标准语通常改用相应动词，如 membersihkan；kasi tahu 通常对应 memberitahu。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kasih+III)

senses.zh_definition: 让；允许某人做某事，或不阻止其行动。
senses.en_definition: To let or allow someone to do something.
senses.ms_definition: Membenarkan atau membiarkan seseorang melakukan sesuatu; tidak menegah.
senses.nuances: 后接人和动作时可表示许可，例如 kasi dia masuk（让他进去）。否定句 tak kasi 常表示不准。须凭上下文区分“允许”与“使得”。[DBP《Kamus Pelajar》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kasi)

etymology.historical_story: Kasi is linked in Malay dictionaries to kasih III, the conversational verb of giving, allowing and causing. That connection offers a safer historical anchor than assigning an unsupported foreign origin. Its several uses form a memorable semantic chain: giving a thing, granting permission, and bringing about a result. The dictionary explicitly marks this everyday verb as colloquial. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kasih+III)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ka.si 记成“给”：给东西是 kasi duit，给机会是 kasi saya cuba，给人消息是 kasi tahu。

morphology.pattern_note: 环缀 ke-…-an 包围词根 hangat，表示温热的状态或相关感受；词根末尾 t 在加元音起首的 -an 后进入末音节，形成 ke.ha.nga.tan。ng 表示单一辅音 /ŋ/，词根拼写不变。

senses.zh_definition: 温热、暖意或热度；温暖或发热的状态。
senses.en_definition: Warmth or heat; the state of being warm or hot.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan bersuhu hangat atau panas.
senses.nuances: 基本的温度义，褒贬取决于环境，可指舒适的暖意，也可指令人不适的热。以下核心义项依据 [DBP PRPM：kehangatan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kehangatan)，马来文释义均作整理改写。

senses.zh_definition: 受到热气影响而发热、感到热。
senses.en_definition: Affected by heat; feeling warm or hot.
senses.ms_definition: Terkena panas sehingga berasa hangat.
senses.nuances: 对应词典中的受热义，可作状态谓语；现代日常表达中，berasa panas 或 kepanasan 往往更直接。不要将此用法一律分析成抽象名词。

senses.zh_definition: 过于温热；热得不适。
senses.en_definition: Excessively warm or hot.
senses.ms_definition: Hangat melebihi tahap yang selesa.
senses.nuances: 对应词典中的过度义，与一般受热义相近，但突出程度过高。相关谓语结构较少见于日常会话，口语通常用 terlalu panas 或 kepanasan。

senses.zh_definition: 活动、欢迎或交往中的热烈气氛；热闹、热情。
senses.en_definition: Liveliness, enthusiasm, or warmth in an occasion, reception, or interaction.
senses.ms_definition: Suasana meriah atau layanan yang penuh kemesraan.
senses.nuances: 由温度引申到社交感受。用于 sambutan 时可突出欢迎的热情或场面的热烈；用于亲情等语境时可进一步表达温馨和关爱。

senses.zh_definition: 争论或局势的激烈、紧张或严峻程度。
senses.en_definition: The intensity or tension of a debate, dispute, or critical situation.
senses.ms_definition: Tahap ketegangan atau kegentingan sesuatu perdebatan atau keadaan.
senses.nuances: 此处的“热”表示冲突和紧张，不能译成温馨或友善。常见于新闻、评论及正式叙述。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈家庭、节庆和接待时通常带正面意味；谈争论时则可能表示紧张。正式报告应写清 kehangatan 所修饰的对象，使读者准确判断语气。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈家庭、节庆和接待时通常带正面意味；谈争论时则可能表示紧张。正式报告应写清 kehangatan 所修饰的对象，使读者准确判断语气。

etymology.historical_story: Kehangatan is built within Malay from hangat and the circumfix ke-…-an. Its meanings follow a memorable path from physical temperature to social and emotional intensity. A welcome can feel warm, a celebration can become lively, and a debate can grow heated. The context determines whether that intensity is comforting, festive, or troubling. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kehangatan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hangat“暖、热”包进 ke-…-an，变成“一股暖意或热度”：身体有温度，欢迎有热情，争论有火药味。

morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将形容词 tamak 名词化，表示贪婪的性质或状态；词根拼写不变。所列 IPA 为按现代拼写读出的形式；输入另记保留阿拉伯来源音的 /kə.ta.ma.ʕan/ 等变体，不能仅凭 Jawi ع 推定所有说话者都读 /ʕ/。

senses.zh_definition: 贪婪；无止境地想占有更多财物、权力或其他利益的心态或品性。
senses.en_definition: Greed; an excessive or insatiable desire to possess wealth, power, or other advantages.
senses.ms_definition: Sifat atau keadaan terlalu ingin memiliki sesuatu tanpa batasan; kehalobaan.
senses.nuances: 明确带贬义，批评欲望过度及只顾自身利益；不等同于正常抱负、进取心或合理需求。定义据 [DBP PRPM：tamak、ketamakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=tamak)改写。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是较强的道德批评。直接指责长辈、上司或不熟悉的人有 ketamakan，容易损害对方面子；沟通分配问题时可先描述具体行为。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于伦理讨论、文学、评论及对不公平分配的批评。朋友间说 tamak 通常比抽象名词 ketamakan 更口语化；涉及贫困、饥饿或合理报酬诉求时，应避免轻率贴上贪婪标签。

etymology.historical_story: Ketamakan combines Malay ke-...-an with tamak, a borrowing associated with Arabic ṭamaʿ, meaning greed or covetous desire. The Jawi spelling طمع preserves the Arabic consonants. Malay moral teaching also warns against excessive wanting through sayings such as orang tamak selalu rugi, discussed in [DBP's cultural commentary](https://dewantamadunislam.jendeladbp.my/2025/04/11/11394/), connecting the word with consequences for oneself and others.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tamak 是“贪心的”，ke-...-an 把品性装进名词框：ketamakan＝贪心这种毛病。

morphology.pattern_note: 整体作为词根记忆；词首 ka- 不是这里的前缀。meN- 与 k 开头词根结合时，k 脱落，形成 mengawatkan。

word_family.gloss: 有金属丝的；装有铁丝的

senses.zh_definition: 金属丝；由铜、铁等金属制成的细长线材，可用于围栏、绑扎或导电。
senses.en_definition: Wire: a thin, elongated strand of metal used for fencing, fastening, conducting electricity, or similar purposes.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan logam yang dibentuk menjadi tali atau jalur halus dan panjang, seperti dawai tembaga atau besi.
senses.nuances: 与 dawai 同义；涉及围栏时 kawat duri 很常见。谈电器接线时，马来西亚口语也常用 wayar；不能把所有 kabel 都理解为单根 kawat。释义据 DBP 改写。[DBP：kawat I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kawat+I)

senses.ms_definition: Berita atau pesanan yang dihantar melalui sistem telegraf; telegram.
senses.nuances: 也见 berita kawat、khabar kawat 和 surat kawat。这个义项指传送的消息，不是承载信号的金属线；现代聊天消息通常称 mesej。[DBP：kawat I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kawat+I)

senses.zh_definition: 队列操练；按统一口令协调进行的列队动作。此义为参见 kawad 的异体用法。
senses.en_definition: Drill or coordinated marching; a cross-referenced variant of kawad.
senses.ms_definition: Perbarisan atau latihan pergerakan serentak oleh pasukan beruniform; varian yang dirujukkan kepada kawad.
senses.nuances: DBP 的释义与答疑中记录了这一用法；现代马来西亚教育、制服团体及正式活动名称通常采用 kawad，学习时宜优先掌握 kawad kaki。[DBP：kawat 与 kawad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kawat+I)

etymology.historical_story: Kawat preserves a small history of communication: the same dictionary entry names both metal wire and a telegram. This pairing offers a memorable connection between a physical transmission medium and the message associated with it. Older expressions such as berita kawat remain useful when reading historical Malay prose. The word's ultimate borrowing source is not established here. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kawat+I)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根 kawat 铜丝：既能围住东西，也能传送电信号；旧时沿线传来的消息就是另一义“电报”。

headword.verification_note: 此处按省略主动前缀的祈使动词处理。输入的 بومي 是词根 bumi 的爪夷文，不是 kebumikan 的完整拼写；此处完整拼写按构词规则转写。音节字段保留输入的 null；IPA 为宽式分析。排名沿用输入，未经独立核实。

morphology.pattern_note: 以 bumi 为词根，经 ke bumi 的方向意义构成动词；kebumikan 可用于祈使句。加主动前缀 meN- 时，开头的 k 被鼻音替代，得到 mengebumikan，而非 mengkebumikan。此处 ke 不宜理解为可自由套用的普通前缀。[DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengebumikan)

senses.zh_definition: 将死者的遗体埋入坟墓；安葬。此形式常用于指令或口语中。
senses.en_definition: Bury or inter a deceased person, especially in an imperative or a construction without the active prefix.
senses.ms_definition: Menanam jenazah di dalam kubur; menguburkan, khususnya dalam bentuk perintah tanpa awalan meN-.
senses.nuances: 这是依据 DBP 对 mengebumikan 的释义改写的形态说明，并非 DBP 对 kebumikan 的逐字释义。普通主动陈述句通常用 mengebumikan，被动句用 dikebumikan。不能因为词根 bumi 意为土地，就把此词泛用于掩埋垃圾。[DBP 释义与用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mengebumikan)

etymology.historical_story: Bumi belongs to the Sanskrit-derived layer of Malay vocabulary, from bhūmi, meaning earth or land. The burial expression builds on the image of placing someone into the earth. Its history therefore combines an older borrowed noun with Malay word formation; it does not make kebumikan itself a Sanskrit word. [Historical linguistic evidence](https://indoling.com/ismil/16/abstracts/Nordhoff.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: DBP marks the adjective karim as an Arabic borrowing. Arabic karīm carries the idea of generosity, which Malay retains in the definition murah hati. Its association with Arabic also helps explain its literary and religious resonance. The dictionary separately records karim as a freshwater fish name; that homonym should not be assigned the adjective’s Arabic origin without further evidence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=36924&keyword=karim)

etymology.historical_story: Kaliber belongs to an international vocabulary represented by English calibre and French calibre. The French Academy traces the French word to Arabic qalib, a casting mould. Malay records both weapon size and personal ability: physical measurement provides a useful bridge to evaluating competence. This comparison does not establish the precise language through which Malay borrowed the word. [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9C0297)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kaliber 联想英语 calibre：量武器是“口径”，评价人才是“水平”；berkaliber 就是“有水平、有才干”。

morphology.formula: ke（独立介词）+ tempat（地点）→ ke tempat；不是 ketempat
morphology.pattern_note: 按通常的方向表达分析，ketempat 是 ke tempat 的误连写。ke 在此是独立介词，不是前缀；词根应参照 tempat，不能把误写形式当作已确认的独立词根。原误写不另立规范音标、音节或爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 通常是 ke tempat 的误连写；规范形式意为“往某个地方”或“到某个场所”。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard joined spelling of ke tempat, meaning 'to a place' or 'to the place'.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan bercantum yang tidak baku bagi frasa ke tempat, yang menunjukkan arah atau tempat yang dituju.
senses.nuances: 这是误写说明，不是独立规范词义。pos 为满足字段范围采用 preposition，具体对应短语中的介词 ke；整个 ke tempat 是介词短语。以下搭配及实际使用例句均采用正确分写。ke tempat 表示目的地，di tempat 表示所在位置。[DBP：ke 的分写规则](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=datang+ke+hadapan)

etymology.historical_story: Ketempat is best explained here as a spacing error, not a word with an independent historical origin. In standard Malay, the directional preposition ke stands separately before a destination expression such as tempat kerja. Joining the two obscures their grammatical roles. Learning the corrected phrase therefore teaches a productive spelling rule that also applies to ke sekolah and ke rumah.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 问“去哪里？”用 ke mana；答案同样分开写：ke tempat。把空格想成通往目的地的一小段路。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 承认过错时表达直接。-ku与aku有关，常见于亲密表达、独白、文学或歌词；正式职场沟通通常用kesalahan saya更稳妥。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 承认过错时表达直接。-ku与aku有关，常见于亲密表达、独白、文学或歌词；正式职场沟通通常用kesalahan saya更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 道歉时可说明具体错误并提出补救办法。kesalahanku本身只表示“我的错误或过错”，不等同于完整的道歉，也不自动表示严重违法。

etymology.historical_story: Kesalahanku illustrates how Malay builds a personal statement from a general concept. Salah supplies the idea of being wrong; ke-...-an forms kesalahan, a noun covering error or wrongdoing; attached -ku identifies the speaker. The resulting word can carry a confession or apology, although its morphology alone does not establish how serious the mistake was.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: salah是“错”，ke-...-an把它装成“错误”这个名词，尾巴-ku贴上“我的”：kesalahanku＝我的错。

morphology.formula: ku-（aku 的前附着形式） + biar + -kan → kubiarkan
morphology.pattern_note: ku- 表示第一人称施事，与 biarkan 连写；它是代词附着形式，不与 -kan 构成派生环缀。词根无辅音交替。资料包将整个词判作词根，应予纠正；音节和音标为补充分析。

word_family.gloss: 任由；不加干涉；置之不理

senses.zh_definition: 由我任由、允许某人做某事，或让某种状态继续存在。
senses.en_definition: Allow or leave someone or something to act or remain in a particular state, with the speaker as agent.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk biarkan dengan proklitik ku- yang menyatakan bahawa aku merelakan, mengizinkan atau tidak menghalang seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 包含“我”这一施事，不能只译成无主语的“让”。标准被动式常把受事放在前面，如 Pintu itu kubiarkan terbuka；文学叙述也可省略明确受事。这里的马来语释义是依据词根义和语法编写的综合释义，并非 DBP 对整个词形的独立引文。

senses.zh_definition: 由我搁置、不理会或不照料某人某事。
senses.en_definition: Leave someone or something unattended, unaddressed or ignored, with the speaker as agent.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk biarkan dengan proklitik ku- yang menyatakan bahawa aku mengabaikan atau tidak mempedulikan seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可表示有意不回应，也可表示疏忽；是否带责备意味取决于对象及后果。kubiarkan sahaja 不一定意味着永久放弃，也可能只是暂时不处理。

nak 对应 mahu；dulu 在这里表示暂时先这样。
日常口语更常说 aku biarkan；kubiarkan 保留一定书面或抒情色彩。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: ku- 对应 aku，适合亲密关系、个人叙述和文学表达。向上司或客户汇报时，通常用 saya membiarkan 更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈到人员照料、工作责任或投诉时，“放着不管”可能暗示失职；应说明是允许、暂缓处理还是疏忽。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: ku- 对应 aku，适合亲密关系、个人叙述和文学表达。向上司或客户汇报时，通常用 saya membiarkan 更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈到人员照料、工作责任或投诉时，“放着不管”可能暗示失职；应说明是允许、暂缓处理还是疏忽。

etymology.historical_story: Kubiarkan illustrates how Malay can express an agent and an action within one written form. The attached ku- represents aku, while biar supplies the meaning of allowing or leaving alone. Adding -kan produces biarkan. This grammatical explanation accounts for the modern form; it does not establish a separate historical origin for kubiarkan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 拆成 ku＝我、biar＝任由、-kan＝构成及物动词：kubiarkan，就是“我任它如此”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，作为独立词素记忆；kon- 和 -tor 在此不是马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 公共汽车上负责售票和收取车费的售票员。

senses.zh_definition: 能够传导热或电的物质或介质；导体。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 职业名称本身中性。向售票员问话时可先说 Encik、Puan 或 Permisi；音乐活动中宜使用对方姓名或正式职衔。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 首次提及时加上 bas、elektrik、haba 或 orkestra，可避免三个义项之间的歧义。不要把公共汽车驾驶员一概称为 konduktor。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 职业名称本身中性。向售票员问话时可先说 Encik、Puan 或 Permisi；音乐活动中宜使用对方姓名或正式职衔。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 首次提及时加上 bas、elektrik、haba 或 orkestra，可避免三个义项之间的歧义。不要把公共汽车驾驶员一概称为 konduktor。

etymology.historical_story: Konduktor belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English conductor. Malay treats the borrowed form as a complete word. Its three established meanings offer a memorable cultural connection: a bus conductor manages fares, a musical conductor directs performers, and a physical conductor carries heat or electricity. This connection explains the meanings without inventing Malay affixes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 联想英语 conductor：车上管票、台上指挥、材料导电导热；共同画面是让人或能量有序通行。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，不可拆成 ke- 加 rak；首音节 e 读 /ə/，词尾 k 通常读 /ʔ/。加 ber- 形成 berkerak。

senses.zh_definition: 附着于物体上的干硬外层，尤指米饭或面包形成的硬层。
senses.en_definition: A hard, dry layer on something, especially a crust of cooked rice or bread.
senses.ms_definition: Lapisan atau selaput yang keras dan kering yang melekat pada sesuatu benda.
senses.nuances: 核心是“干硬的一层”，不必然表示烧焦或肮脏。kerak nasi 指锅底硬饭层；kerak roti 指面包的硬外皮。

collocations.en: the rice crust at the bottom of a pot

senses.zh_definition: 附着在器物表面、硬化后不易去除的积垢或沉积层。
senses.en_definition: A hardened deposit or encrusted residue adhering to a surface.
senses.ms_definition: Lapisan sisa atau kotoran yang telah mengeras dan melekat pada permukaan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是核心“干硬附着层”意义在清洁语境中的应用。可指水壶沉积物或锅具残留物；不能泛指所有污渍。

collocations.en: scale on the bottom of a kettle

senses.zh_definition: 在地质术语 kerak bumi 中，指地球最外侧的固体岩石层，即地壳。
senses.en_definition: The Earth's outermost solid rocky layer, in kerak bumi.
senses.ms_definition: Lapisan batuan pepejal yang paling luar pada bumi.
senses.nuances: 固定术语为 kerak bumi，不等于普通地表泥土，也不等于整个岩石圈。此处采用现代地学表述。

collocations.en: the thickness of the Earth's crust

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述食物或器具时是中性词；若直接说别人衣物 berkerak，往往带“积垢严重”的嫌弃意味，容易让人难堪。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: kerak nasi 不必然表示食物坏了或不能吃。谚语 jangan diajar orang tua makan kerak 意为不要教有经验的人做其熟悉的事，对他人直接说可能显得讥讽。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述食物或器具时是中性词；若直接说别人衣物 berkerak，往往带“积垢严重”的嫌弃意味，容易让人难堪。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: kerak nasi 不必然表示食物坏了或不能吃。谚语 jangan diajar orang tua makan kerak 意为不要教有经验的人做其熟悉的事，对他人直接说可能显得讥讽。

etymology.historical_story: Kerak is a Malay base word for a hard, dry layer. Its dictionary examples connect the kitchen with the physical world: rice stuck to a pot, bread crust and the Earth's crust. Traditional proverbs also use rice crust to evoke experience and hardship. These examples reveal the word's cultural associations without establishing a particular ancient source or borrowing history. [Kamus Dewan via DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kerak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住锅底那层硬饭焦：食物上的硬层、器物上的硬垢、地球外面的硬壳，都抓住“硬的一层”。

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowing. Lemah supplies the idea of weakness; ke-...-an turns that quality into the noun kelemahan. Adding -nya links the weakness to a referent supplied by the conversation. The resulting meaning is compositional, so a separate dictionary entry is unnecessary for understanding its structure. [DBP lemah entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=lemah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步记忆：lemah＝弱；ke-...-an 把“弱”变成“弱点”；再接 -nya＝他、她或所谈对象的弱点。

senses.zh_definition: 肉眼看不见的微小生物，如细菌；日常卫生语境中常指可能致病的病菌。
senses.en_definition: A microscopic organism, especially a bacterium; commonly a disease-causing germ.
senses.ms_definition: Organisma seni yang tidak kelihatan dengan mata kasar, termasuk bakteria, yang terdapat dalam pelbagai persekitaran dan ada antaranya menyebabkan penyakit.
senses.nuances: 词典义不限于有害生物，不能理解为所有微生物都会致病。日常卫生用语中的 kuman 较宽泛，专业文本应按实际对象使用更具体的术语。马来文释义依据词典改写，并非逐字引文：[DBP：kuman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kuman)。

senses.zh_definition: 极细微的东西；比喻极小的事物或微不足道的过失。
senses.en_definition: Something extremely small or minute, especially in figurative or proverbial use.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang amat halus atau kecil, digunakan secara kiasan, termasuk dalam peribahasa.
senses.nuances: 常见于谚语，不宜机械用于一切“小东西”。关于远处 kuman 与眼前 gajah 的对比，比喻看得见别人的小错，却看不见自己的大错。以下为谚语用例，并非普通自由搭配：[DBP：kuman 的比喻义与谚语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kuman)。

collocations.en: notice others' smallest faults while overlooking one's own glaring faults

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverbs place the tiny kuman beside the enormous elephant to expose unequal judgment: another person's slightest fault attracts attention while one's own major failing goes unnoticed. This cultural image complements the word's everyday association with microscopic organisms. It illustrates established figurative usage without claiming an unsupported ancient origin. [DBP proverb reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=kuman).

etymology.historical_story: Malay koktel adapts English cocktail to local spelling and pronunciation. Its dictionary meanings preserve two culinary settings: mixed alcoholic drinks and small dishes of fruit or seafood. The English word's ultimate origin remains uncertain, so colourful stories about rooster tails should be treated as folklore rather than established linguistic history. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=koktel); [English etymology](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/cocktail)
